source_top.description: Path of the input TOP to apply the time effect to (e.g. '/project1/moviefilein1' or a Null TOP). REQUIRED.

mode.description: echo: recursive feedback trails — each frame leaves a fading ghost (the classic 'echo trails' / time-blur look, driven by `feedback`). slit_scan: buffer N frames in a cache and read different rows from different points in time (rolling 'time slice' wipe). time_displace: per-pixel time offset driven by a gradient (`displace_top`) — bright pixels show older frames, dark show newer (the 'time_machine' melt/warp). slit_scan and time_displace both buffer frames in a cacheTOP and read them back with a time-machine TOP.

frames.description: Buffer depth / cache size in frames for slit_scan and time_displace (how far back in time pixels can be pulled). Ignored in echo mode (feedback is recursive, not frame-indexed). Larger = longer time range but more GPU memory.

feedback.description: Echo trail strength [0–1] for echo mode — opacity of the fed-back previous frame blended over the current one. Higher = longer, more persistent trails (0.5 = balanced; 0.9+ = very smeary). Ignored in slit_scan / time_displace.

displace_top.description: time_displace mode only: path of a TOP whose luminance maps each pixel to a time offset (a gradient/ramp/noise — bright = further back in time). Omit to use a built-in vertical ramp (rampTOP) so the effect works out of the box. Ignored in echo / slit_scan.

resolution.description: Forced output resolution [width, height] in pixels. A fixed resolution is REQUIRED for the feedback path (echo mode) so the loop has a stable frame from cook 0 and does not stay black.

tools.name: create_capture_loop
tools.description: Build a bidirectional inter-app video bridge to another program (Resolume, OBS, MadMapper, a game engine…) in one container: receive an external feed IN and publish a TOP OUT at the same time. Picks the right operators per protocol — NDI (network, macOS & Windows), or Syphon (macOS) / Spout (Windows). direction 'in' only subscribes, 'out' only publishes, 'both' runs a full round-trip loop. The receive half is a receiver TOP → Null 'in_out'; the send half pulls source_top through a Select TOP into a publisher TOP. ANTI-FEEDBACK: the two halves are never wired together, so 'both' won't loop this app's own output back in. PLATFORM-GATED & largely UNVERIFIED-live: Spout needs Windows, Syphon needs macOS, and sender/receiver-name parameter names vary by TD build (probed at runtime) — the wrong platform or a real signal needs the actual sender present. This is the combined in+out version of create_live_source (in) and setup_output (out).

parent_path.description: COMP to build the capture-loop container in (e.g. '/project1').

name.description: Base name for the container COMP that holds the in/out bridge.

protocol.description: Inter-app video transport. ndi works on macOS & Windows (network). spout is Windows-only; syphon is macOS-only — both use the same Syphon/Spout TOPs in TouchDesigner (PLATFORM-GATED: the wrong platform fails to create the op, reported as a warning).

direction.description: in: only receive an external feed. out: only publish a TOP. both: do both at once (a full round-trip loop to another app, e.g. send to Resolume and receive its output back).

sender_name.description: (out) The public name THIS app publishes its feed under, so the other app can find it. Used for direction 'out'/'both'.

receiver_name.description: (in) The name of the EXTERNAL sender to subscribe to. Empty = pick the first available sender on the network/machine. Used for direction 'in'/'both'.

source_top.description: (out) Path of the TOP to publish when direction includes 'out' (e.g. '/project1/final'). Empty together with an 'out' direction publishes nothing and is flagged as a warning.

resolution.description: Working resolution [w, h] applied to the receiver TOP (Output Resolution = Custom). The publisher inherits its input TOP's resolution.

tools.name: create_auto_montage
tools.description: Point at a folder and build a self-running clip montage: scans the folder for clips/stills, builds one Movie File In TOP per file feeding a Switch TOP (fractional-index crossfade) → Null TOP, and adds an auto-advance brain on top — a Beat CHOP (clock='beat' or 'bar' with division) or LFO CHOP (clock='interval') drives a CHOP-Execute DAT that picks the next clip per `mode` (sequential / random / shuffle-no-repeat / weighted) and animates the Switch index with a crossfade. Exposes Play / Index / Next / Prev / Crossfade / Bpm / Division / Mode / Seed custom pars on the container; emits a state_out Null CHOP so bind_to_channel can read clip_index/beat. Folder is read inside TD. Missing folder → empty pointable montage instead of error.

parent_path.description: Where to build it.

folder.description: Folder on the TD machine to scan for clips/stills.

resolution.description: Switch TOP output resolution [w,h].

mode.description: Sequence policy: sequential, random, shuffle (no immediate repeat), weighted (per-clip Weight par).

clock.description: Trigger source: beat/bar (Beat CHOP) or interval (LFO CHOP).

division.description: Advance every N beats (beat) or N bars (bar).

tools.name: create_euclidean_sequencer
tools.description: Build a Euclidean rhythm sequencer: given `pulses` evenly distributed across `steps` via Bjorklund's algorithm (with optional cyclic `rotation`), it writes the resulting on/off pattern to a Table DAT and fires one dispatch per active step on each beat boundary. The deterministic, mathematically-grounded sibling of create_beat_grid_sequencer — program rhythms by musical intent (e.g. E(3,8) tresillo, E(5,8) cinquillo, E(4,16) four-on-the-floor) rather than by hand-editing cells. Sweep the Pulses/Rotation custom parameters live and the table re-shapes in place. action=param sets a custom parameter to on_value/off_value per step; action=cue recalls a cue per active step (cues stored with manage_cue). NOTE: beat-callback timing is UNVERIFIED offline — check op().time.play if steps don't fire when the TD timeline is paused.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path to create the sequencer inside.

target.description: COMP whose parameter or cue each active step fires on a beat boundary.

steps.description: Number of steps in the Euclidean grid.

pulses.description: Number of active pulses distributed evenly across `steps` via Bjorklund's algorithm. Clamped to <= steps at build time.

rotation.description: Cyclic rotation of the generated pattern (downbeat offset).

action.description: param: set a target custom-parameter value per active step; cue: recall a named cue per active step (cues stored with manage_cue).

param.description: (action=param) The custom-parameter name on the target COMP to set on each active step.

on_value.description: (action=param) Value written into the table cell for active steps.

off_value.description: (action=param) Value written into the table cell for inactive steps.

bpm_source.description: Path to an existing Beat CHOP or tempo source. Omit to create a new Beat CHOP (on the global TD tempo).

tools.name: create_preset_morph
tools.description: Target-agnostic preset morph engine: snapshot any OP's animatable parameters into N named slots, then blend between them with a weight vector (or a single A↔B recall) through a Lag CHOP + Lookup curve, exposing the live blended values on a Null CHOP for bind_to_channel consumers. Unlike create_look_bank (which is scoped to a control COMP's custom pars with a 2-slot A↔B knob), this drives any OP and supports >2 simultaneous weights (normalized internally). Reuses manage_cue's MORPH_HOOK for beat/bar quantized recall. Note: Lag CHOP does not advance while the timeline is paused.

action.description: build: create the morph container. store: snapshot the target's animatable parameters into a named slot. recall: snap or crossfade the target to one slot. set_weights: drive an N-way weighted blend across all stored slots (vector is clipped to >=0 and normalized). list / delete slots.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP where the morph container is built.

name.description: Name of the morph container (baseCOMP) created inside parent_path.

target_path.description: The node whose parameters are snapshotted and driven (required for build/store). Any OP with animatable numeric/toggle/menu pars.

include.description: (store) Restrict the snapshot to these parameter names (tuplet names like 'tx', 'feedback'). Omit to capture every animatable numeric/toggle/menu parameter (pulses, strings, file refs are always skipped).

slot.description: Slot name (required for store / recall / delete).

weights.description: (set_weights) Map of slot-name -> weight. Negatives clipped to 0; the vector is normalized internally (sum -> 1) before lerp. Missing slots default to 0.

morph_seconds.description: (recall) 0 = snap; >0 = ease to slot over this many seconds via a Lag CHOP on the weight vector. Note: Lag CHOP does not advance while the timeline is paused.

quantize.description: (recall) Defer the snap/crossfade to the next musical boundary (project tempo). Mirrors manage_cue / create_look_bank.

interpolation.description: Interpolation curve applied to each parameter when crossfading. linear is a straight lerp; cosine/cubic shape the lagged weights through a Lookup CHOP curve.

tools.name: create_scene_timeline
tools.description: Build a scrubbable show timeline: a single Timer-CHOP playhead drives ordered scenes that recall cues on a target COMP. Sits above create_cue_sequencer (beat-quantized) and create_scheduler (event-firing) as the show's master clock. Exposes Play/Pause/Stop/Seek/Rate/Loop/Active_Scene custom pars + a playhead Null CHOP (t_seconds, t_norm, scene_idx, scene_t). Consumes the foundation setlist schema: when setlist_path is given, each scene's setlist_slot is mirrored into tdmcp_scenes for downstream tools. Bars→seconds conversion uses BPM 120 + 4 beats-per-bar at build time (no auto-rescale on tempo change).

target.description: COMP that owns the cues (tdmcp_cues). Store scenes' cues first with manage_cue.

name.description: Human label for the scene; used in the live control row + Active_Scene readout.

cue.description: Name of a cue stored on `target` via manage_cue. Recalled when the playhead enters.

start.description: Start offset on the timeline, in `units` (seconds or bars).

duration.description: Length of this scene on the timeline, in `units`.

morph_in_seconds.description: Crossfade duration entering this scene from the previous one. 0 = snap.

setlist_slot.description: OPTIONAL setlist slot id (resolved against `setlist_path`) for downstream cross-refs.

scenes.description: Ordered scene list (sorted by `start` at build time). Overlaps drive morphs.

units.description: Input unit for `start`/`duration`/`morph_in_seconds`. 'bars' is converted to seconds at build time using BPM 120 + 4 beats-per-bar (no auto-rescale on tempo change).

loop.description: End of last scene → wrap to 0.

rate.description: Playback rate multiplier (Timer CHOP speed). Exposed as a live custom par.

autoplay.description: Pulse the Timer's start on cook when true.

setlist_path.description: OPTIONAL path to a DAT holding the foundation-setlist JSON. When present, scene.setlist_slot is stored alongside each scene in tdmcp_scenes for downstream tools.

parent_path.description: Parent path where the engine COMP lives.

tools.name: create_scheduler
tools.description: Build a Timer-CHOP scheduler COMP: one or more named timers (seconds or beats), each with an optional ordered segment list, sharing a Callbacks DAT that fires a cue/param/script action on onDone and onSegmentEnter. Atomic timer primitive that create_scene_timeline and other automation rides on. Reuses manage_cue's tdmcp_cues storage for the default 'cue' action - store target cues first with manage_cue.

name.description: Timer name -> the Timer CHOP node name (and the 'timer' field the callback reports). Must be unique within the scheduler.

length.description: Total length when this timer has no segments. Ignored (a warning is added) when segments is non-empty.

length_unit.description: Unit for length and every segment length. 'seconds' = wall-clock; 'beats' = musical, locked to the global tempo.

segments.description: Optional ordered segment list. When present, the timer runs named segments back-to-back and fires onSegmentEnter at each boundary.

name.description: Segment name; written to the Segments DAT and reported by the onSegmentEnter callback.

length.description: Length of this segment, in the parent timer's length_unit (seconds or beats). The timer's total run = sum of its segment lengths.

loop.description: true -> the timer cycles forever (Cycle on, Cycle Limit off) and onDone fires once per cycle; false -> runs once to Done.

autostart.description: true -> initialize + start the timer on build so it begins counting immediately; false -> primed but stopped.

timers.description: One or more named timers built inside the scheduler COMP. Each becomes a Timer CHOP + segment Table DAT, all sharing one Callbacks DAT.

name.description: Name of the scheduler engine COMP (a containerCOMP) created inside parent_path. Re-running with the same name reuses it.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the scheduler COMP is created inside.

action.description: What the callbacks fire. 'cue': recall a cue (reuses manage_cue's tdmcp_cues). 'param': set target.par.param. 'script': artist-edited stub.

target.description: (action cue/param) COMP the callback acts on. For 'cue', store the cues first with manage_cue.

param.description: (action param) Custom-parameter name on target the callback sets.

on_done_value.description: (action param) Value written to target.par.param on onDone.

expose_controls.description: Append an Active toggle on the scheduler COMP, so a dashboard can pause callback dispatch live.

tools.name: create_glsl_material
tools.description: Create a GLSL MAT under parent_path for custom-shaded geometry. Caller shader source requires TDMCP_RAW_PYTHON=on and TDMCP_BRIDGE_ALLOW_EXEC=1. The pixel/vertex/(optional) geometry shader source is placed in companion Text DATs (`<name>_pix`/`_vert`/`_geo`) and wired to the GLSL MAT's pixel/vertex/geometry parameters; numeric uniforms are best-effort bound on the Vectors sequence and samplers on the Samplers sequence. Pixel shader must declare `out vec4 fragColor;`. Returns the GLSL MAT path, the DAT paths, and warnings for known TD GLSL footguns (missing fragColor, F1/F2 preamble collision, undeclared uTime, sampler bindings needing manual wiring). Artist assigns the MAT to a Geometry COMP via its `material` par.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP to create the GLSL MAT + DATs inside.

pixel_shader.description: GLSL pixel/fragment shader source. Must declare `out vec4 fragColor;`.

uniforms.description: Optional uniform declarations to best-effort bind on the GLSL MAT.

name.description: Uniform name as declared in the shader.

type.description: GLSL uniform type. Numeric → Vectors page; sampler* → Samplers page.

top_path.description: For sampler* uniforms: TOP path to bind into the Samplers sequence.

tools.name: scaffold_tool_generator
tools.description: Meta DX tool: scaffolds a new tdmcp tool file (xSchema + xImpl + registerX) and a matching offline msw unit test from a one-line idea. Returns the exact integration-hint (import line + array entry + layer index path) so the integrator can wire it without re-deciding shape. No TouchDesigner bridge call — pure local filesystem generator.

repo_root.description: Repo root (default: process.cwd()); for tests use a tmpdir

tools.name: extend_data_source_fabric
tools.description: Adds extra transports to the data-source fabric beyond create_data_source: 'mqtt' subscribes to a broker, 'ws-binary' streams binary frames over a WebSocket, 'midi-mmc' listens for MIDI Machine Control transport bytes (play/stop/record/locate). Same downstream shape as create_data_source — a Null DAT for the raw text/bytes and a Null CHOP whose channels are ready for bind_to_channel / create_data_visualization.

transport.description: Which transport branch to build. 'mqtt' subscribes to a broker, 'ws-binary' streams binary frames over a WebSocket, 'midi-mmc' listens for MIDI Machine Control transport bytes.

parent_path.description: COMP to build the sub-network inside.

name.description: Base name for the created sub-network.

host.description: (mqtt/ws-binary) Broker or WebSocket host. Ignored by midi-mmc.

topic.description: (mqtt) Subscription topic(s), comma-separated. (ws-binary) URL path, e.g. '/stream'.

tls.description: (mqtt/ws-binary) Use TLS — flips mqtts:// or wss://.

device.description: (midi-mmc) MIDI input device name. Omit to use the first device.

frame_format.description: (ws-binary) How each frame's bytes decode into numeric samples.

channels.description: (ws-binary) Number of numeric channels per frame to expose on the Null CHOP.

fields.description: (mqtt) JSON keys to extract from each message into the sample table → Null CHOP channels.

expose_controls.description: Surface an 'Active' toggle (and a 'Reconnect' pulse for mqtt/ws-binary).

tools.name: build_chop_chain
tools.description: Declarative Layer-2 builder for an ordered CHOP processing chain. Pass an `ops` list (type + optional name + optional params); each op[i] is wired output 0 → input 0 of op[i+1] under `parent` (default `/project1`). Per-op create/param/connect failures become warnings (fail-forward) — a partial chain still returns useful info. Tip: end the chain in a `nullCHOP` to make it `bind_to_channel`-ready.

name.description: Base name for the chain; used as a name prefix when ops omit `name`, and as the chain's reported id.

type.description: CHOP operator type (e.g. `audiofileinCHOP`, `mathCHOP`, `lagCHOP`, `filterCHOP`, `nullCHOP`). Must end with `CHOP`.

name.description: Optional explicit node name. Defaults to '<name>_<i>_<typeStem>' (the type with trailing CHOP stripped).

params.description: Parameter name → value map applied after creation. A string value matching an earlier op's name resolves to that op's absolute path.

ops.description: Ordered list of CHOPs. Each op[i] is wired output 0 → input 0 of op[i+1].

tools.name: author_script_operator
tools.description: Scaffold a Script CHOP/DAT/SOP/TOP with a ready-to-edit onCook(scriptOp) stub and optional custom parameters. Creates the Script op plus its companion callbacks DAT, writes a per-family stub (chan/row/point/numpy) — or your `on_cook_body` — and appends Float/Toggle/Str custom pars inferred from each default's type. Returns {op_path, callbacks_path, params_added, warnings}. Requires TDMCP_RAW_PYTHON=on and TDMCP_BRIDGE_ALLOW_EXEC=1. Note: Script ops only cook when something requests them, so a paused timeline + no downstream consumer means no cook (not a bug).

parent_path.description: Parent COMP to create the Script op inside.

name.description: Name for the Script op; TD auto-names when omitted.

family.description: Script op family — selects the operator type and the onCook stub signature.

custom_params.description: Custom parameters to append on the Script op's 'Custom' page.

name.description: Custom parameter name; normalized to a TD-legal identifier.

default.description: Initial value; type infers the parameter family (number→Float, bool→Toggle, string→Str).

on_cook_body.description: Optional body for onCook(scriptOp); injected verbatim. When omitted a per-family no-op stub is used.

tools.name: create_shared_memory_bridge
tools.description: Create a Shared Memory In/Out TOP/CHOP for zero-copy IPC with another app on the same host (Notch, Unity, Unreal, custom tools). Pick direction ('in' to receive, 'out' to publish), kind (TOP for pixel buffers, CHOP for numeric channels), and a shmName that the peer must match exactly. After creating an Out variant, wire the producer TOP/CHOP into it with connect_nodes. When format.header=false the peer reads a raw headerless buffer — sizes must agree exactly or frames will garble. Some (direction, kind) combos are platform/build-dependent; the tool returns a friendly fatal if the optype isn't available.

direction.description: 'in' = receive from an external app; 'out' = publish to an external app.

kind.description: TOP = pixel buffer (RGBA frames); CHOP = numeric channels (control / audio-rate).

shmName.description: Shared-memory segment name. Must match exactly on both sides. Two TDs using the same name will collide.

parent.description: COMP path to create the operator in.

name.description: Operator name; auto-generated when omitted (e.g. shm_in / shm_out).

format.description: Optional format hints. Unknown / unsupported pars on this build become warnings.

pixelFormat.description: (TOP) pixel format — best-effort mapping to the operator's menu.

numChannels.description: (CHOP, out) channel count when the operator wants it pinned.

header.description: Include the TD header block in the segment (`header` par). When false, the peer reads a raw headerless buffer of exact size — easy to garble.

tools.name: build_sop_geometry
tools.description: Declarative Layer-2 builder for an ordered SOP geometry chain. Pass an `ops` list (type + optional name + optional params); each op[i] is wired output 0 → input 0 of op[i+1] under `parent` (default `/project1`). Per-op create/param/connect failures become warnings (fail-forward) — a partial chain still returns useful info. Tip: end the chain in a `nullSOP` for a stable handoff to Geometry COMPs, SOP-to-CHOP, or convertSOP. Use `connect_nodes` for multi-input fan-in (e.g. mergeSOP, copySOP template).

name.description: Base name for the chain; used as a name prefix when ops omit `name`, and as the chain's reported id.

type.description: SOP operator type (e.g. `boxSOP`, `sphereSOP`, `gridSOP`, `transformSOP`, `noiseSOP`, `mergeSOP`, `copySOP`, `nullSOP`). Must end with `SOP`.

name.description: Optional explicit node name. Defaults to '<name>_<i>_<typeStem>' (the type with trailing SOP stripped).

params.description: Parameter name → value map applied after creation. A string value matching an earlier op's name resolves to that op's absolute path (useful for `sop` refs on copySOP, mergeSOP, etc.).

ops.description: Ordered list of SOPs. Each op[i] is wired output 0 → input 0 of op[i+1].

tools.name: sync_timecode
tools.description: Wire an external SMPTE/MTC/LTC/OSC timecode source into the TouchDesigner timeline. Creates the input op + Math CHOP normaliser + Null CHOP 'tc_out' (channels 'frame' and 'seconds'); optionally adds an Execute DAT that writes project.frame = tc_out['frame'] each cook so the timeline follows house clock. Requires the project to be playing — paused TD will not advance. LTC has no native TD decoder; the tool surfaces a warning and creates the audio input so the artist can attach an external decoder. MTC operator availability is build-dependent.

name.description: Name prefix for the timecode subsystem COMP (defaults to 'tc_in1').

parent.description: COMP to host the timecode subsystem in.

source.description: Timecode transport: 'mtc' = MIDI Time Code (MIDI In), 'ltc' = Linear Time Code from audio (no native TD decoder — surfaces a warning), 'osc' = OSC In CHOP listening on host:port.

host.description: (osc) Bind interface; ignored for mtc/ltc. Defaults to '0.0.0.0'.

port.description: (osc) UDP port (default 7000) or (mtc/ltc) device index (default 0). The device picker can hang on a macOS permission modal — keep the default unless you know the device.

osc_address.description: (osc) OSC address pattern carrying the timecode payload. Defaults to '/timecode'.

drive_timeline.description: When true, an Execute DAT writes project.frame = tc_out['frame'] each cook. Requires the project to be playing — paused TD will not advance.

cue_on_label.description: (osc) If the payload is a string matching a project cue name, call project.cue(name) instead of seeking.

tools.name: apply_lut
tools.description: Apply a colour Look-Up Table (LUT) to an existing TOP inside a self-contained baseCOMP. Prefers an OpenColorIO TOP for `.cube`/`.3dl`/`.cc`/`.ccc` files; falls back to a Movie File In + Lookup TOP for image LUTs or when OCIO is unavailable. A `.cube` file with no OCIO is parsed in Python into a Script TOP ramp. Exposes Strength and Bypass controls on a custom page. Pass `source_path` to grade an existing TOP, or omit it for a standalone preview on a grey Constant TOP.

lut_path.description: Absolute path to the LUT file. Accepts `.cube`, `.3dl`, `.cc`, `.ccc` (routed to OpenColorIO when available, otherwise parsed in Python for `.cube` or loaded via Movie File In for image-format LUTs). PNG/EXR/etc. always use the Movie File In + Lookup TOP fallback.

source_path.description: Absolute TD path of the existing TOP to grade (e.g. '/project1/render1'). TD wires can't cross COMPs, so the source is pulled in via a Select TOP referencing the absolute path. When omitted, a Constant TOP (mid-grey, 1280×720) is created as a stand-in so the chain cooks and previews standalone.

ocio_config_path.description: Optional absolute path to an OCIO config file (`.ocio`). Only used when the OCIO branch is taken.

strength.description: Blend amount between source (0 = untouched) and graded output (1 = full LUT). Drives the Cross TOP crossfade parameter.

bypass.description: When true, forces the Cross TOP crossfade to 0 so the source passes through unchanged. Also exposed as a toggle on the custom page.

prefer.description: Branch selection. `auto` probes OpenColorIO availability at runtime and uses it for `.cube`/`.3dl`/`.cc`/`.ccc` files, falling back to the Lookup TOP path for images. `ocio` forces the OCIO branch. `lookup` forces the Movie File In + Lookup TOP path even when OCIO is available.

expose_controls.description: When true, appends custom-page parameters Strength (float 0..1) and Bypass (toggle) on the container COMP and binds them to the Cross TOP crossfade.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP network where the LUT chain container is created.

container_name.description: Base name for the container COMP (a numeric suffix is auto-applied by TD).

tools.name: create_npr_filter
tools.description: Apply a non-photorealistic painterly filter to an existing TOP. A generalized Kuwahara (sector-based local variance smoothing) runs in a single GLSL TOP and branches into three looks selected by `mode`: oil (flat color regions, preserved edges), pencil (graphite sketch via luminance × edge magnitude), or watercolor (quantized chroma + low-frequency bleed). Creates a Select TOP → GLSL TOP → Null TOP chain under `parent_path` and exposes Radius / Smoothness / Strength as custom parent params bound by expression for live tweaking. Returns the GLSL TOP path, the bind-ready output null path, the fragment DAT path, exposed controls, and an `glsl_compile_verified` flag (always false offline — verify post-cook with `get_td_node_errors`).

source_path.description: Absolute path of an existing TOP to filter (e.g. '/project1/render1'). Pulled in via a Select TOP (no cross-COMP wire).

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path to create the glslTOP + textDAT + nullTOP inside.

name.description: Base name for the glslTOP (textDAT becomes `<name>_frag`, output becomes `<name>_out`, source select becomes `<name>_src`).

mode.description: Painterly look. oil: full Kuwahara → flat color regions with preserved edges. pencil: luminance + edge-mag → graphite sketch. watercolor: quantize chroma + low-freq bleed.

radius.description: Sampling radius in texels. Cost is O(radius² · sectors) — keep modest on 4K.

sectors.description: Number of generalized-Kuwahara sectors. 8 = smoother painterly; 4 = classic Kuwahara (cheaper).

smoothness.description: Blend between hard min-variance sector pick (0) and softmax-weighted average across sectors (1). Live control.

strength.description: Wet/dry mix between source (0) and filtered output (1). Live control.

resolution.description: Output resolution: 'input' inherits from the source (default), or '720p' (1280x720), '1080p' (1920x1080), '4K' (3840x2160).

tools.name: post_passes_3d
tools.description: Compose a chain of 3D-aware post-processing passes (SSAO, SSR, DOF, motion blur) inside a new baseCOMP. Each pass is a glslTOP with companion textDAT that samples color + depth + (optional) normal/velocity AOVs from selectTOPs. Passes run in fixed order SSAO → SSR → DOF → MB and emit a final null TOP ('out1'). SSR is skipped with a warning when normal_top is empty; motion blur falls back to a directional blur when velocity_top is empty; if color_top points at a renderTOP and depth_top is empty, a sibling depthTOP is auto-created (best-effort). Returns container/output paths, the resolved AOV paths, the enabled passes, and any warnings.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP for the post-pass container.

name.description: Name of the created baseCOMP container.

color_top.description: Absolute path of the beauty-pass TOP (Render TOP / Null TOP).

depth_top.description: Absolute path of the depth TOP. Empty = auto-derive from a sibling depthTOP when color is a renderTOP.

normal_top.description: Absolute path of the normal-AOV TOP. Empty = SSR is skipped (warning).

velocity_top.description: Absolute path of the velocity-AOV TOP. Empty = motion blur falls back to directional.

tools.name: create_flow_abstraction
tools.description: Build a two-pass Kyprianidis-style flow abstraction: an edge-tangent-flow (ETF) bilateral smoother followed by a flow-based DoG (FDoG) line extractor — oil-painting smooth interiors with crisp coherent ink edges. Creates two glslTOPs + companion textDATs under parent_path, fed by a Select TOP from the source TOP and terminated by a Null TOP. Strength/Edge/Iterations are exposed as live parent-par-bound uniforms; blur radius, sigmas and tau are baked in at build time. Iterations boosts effective ETF strength in-shader (single-input pass, no ping-pong feedback).

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path to create the two GLSL TOPs in.

name.description: Base name; nodes become <name>_etf, <name>_fdog, <name>_out, plus *_frag textDATs.

source.description: Absolute path of the input TOP to abstract (e.g. '/project1/movie1'). Pulled in via a Select TOP so cross-container wiring is safe.

edge.description: FDoG edge gain — multiplier on the DoG response before thresholding.

iterations.description: Number of ETF passes; higher values boost ETF strength via an in-shader uniform. No external feedback loop is created in this version.

blur_radius.description: ETF bilateral kernel half-width in texels along the tangent (kernel ≈ 2*radius+1).

sigma_r.description: FDoG outer Gaussian sigma — usually ≈ 1.6 * sigma_e.

resolution.description: Output res; 'input' inherits.

tools.name: create_data_source_http_ws
tools.description: Advanced live-data ingest for HTTP polling and WebSocket streams — the richer-transport sibling of create_data_source. http_poll: webclientDAT driven by a timerCHOP so polling cadence is a real CHOP signal you can retune/sync; supports custom HTTP method, headers, and body. websocket: websocketDAT with auto-reconnect, persistent connection. Both: JSONPath-lite selectors ($.key, $.key.sub, $.arr[0].field — no wildcards/filters) map response fields to named channels on an output Null CHOP ready for bind_to_channel. Raw body exposed on a Null DAT. Use create_data_source for simple one-knob JSON/CSV polling; use this tool when you need real POST/headers, fine-cadence timer sync, or a WebSocket stream.

mode.description: Transport.

parent_path.description: COMP to build inside.

name.description: Base name for the created baseCOMP; defaults to data_src_<mode>.

url.description: Endpoint URL. http(s):// for http_poll; ws:// or wss:// for websocket. Note: webclientDAT runs inside TD (no browser CORS). wss:// with self-signed certs may silently fail (statusCode 0). JSONPath selector support: $.name, $.key.sub, $.arr[0].field — no wildcards or filters.

method.description: HTTP method. http_poll only; ignored for websocket.

headers.description: Request headers (http_poll) or connect headers (websocket; best-effort, param may vary by TD build).

body.description: Request body. http_poll only; caller pre-serializes JSON.

selectors.description: JSONPath-lite selectors. Each name becomes a Null CHOP channel and must be unique. path must start with $. Supported: $.key, $.key.sub, $.arr[0], $.arr[0].key. Non-numeric or missing values fall back to 0 with a warning.

poll_seconds.description: Polling interval in seconds. http_poll only; drives the timerCHOP cycle.

reconnect_seconds.description: Seconds between reconnect attempts. websocket only.

expose_controls.description: Surface live Active, Poll/Reconnect, and per-selector LastValue readouts.

static_sample.description: Seed values keyed by selector name. Missing names default to 0.5.

tools.name: setup_face_tracking
tools.description: One-shot face-landmark tracking from a webcam: loads the MediaPipe ENGINE (install first with `tdmcp install mediapipe-touchdesigner`), starts the timeline, and builds an adapter Script CHOP that emits a 468-sample (or 478 with iris) face-landmark CHOP (tx/ty/tz/confidence, centred on nose tip). Feeds directly into bind_to_channel and create_data_visualization.

tox_path.description: Path to the MediaPipe ENGINE .tox (MediaPipe.tox). Defaults to the package staged by `tdmcp install mediapipe-touchdesigner`, falling back to ~/tdmcp-packages.

parent_path.description: COMP to load the engine into.

num_landmarks.description: 468 = MediaPipe FaceMesh base; 478 adds iris landmarks (10 extra) when iris tracking is enabled in the engine.

tools.name: setup_hand_tracking
tools.description: One-shot MediaPipe hand tracking from a webcam: loads the mediapipe-touchdesigner ENGINE (install with `tdmcp install mediapipe-touchdesigner`), starts the timeline, locates the engine's hand JSON DAT, and builds an adapter Script CHOP that converts the hand JSON into a canonical max_hands×21-landmark CHOP (channels: tx/ty/tz/confidence/handedness). Use coordinate_space='world' for gesture detection (3D, curled fingers separate in z). The output CHOP at <parent_path>/<adapter_name>/hand is ready for bind_to_channel or create_pose_skeleton. Shares the same engine as setup_body_tracking — both can run in the same project.

tox_path.description: Path to the MediaPipe ENGINE .tox (MediaPipe.tox). Defaults to the package staged by `tdmcp install mediapipe-touchdesigner`, falling back to ~/tdmcp-packages. The same engine is shared with setup_body_tracking.

parent_path.description: COMP to load the engine into.

max_hands.description: Maximum number of hands tracked (1 or 2). Output CHOP allocates max_hands*21 samples.

coordinate_space.description: 'world' reads worldLandmarks (3D, meters, gesture-safe — curled fingers separate in z). 'image' reads normalised 2D landmarks, centred on the wrist. Use 'world' for gesture detection.

adapter_name.description: baseCOMP name created under parent_path to house the hand Script CHOP.

tools.name: setup_segmentation
tools.description: One-shot selfie segmentation via the MediaPipe TouchDesigner engine (install with `tdmcp install mediapipe-touchdesigner`). Loads the engine, enables Selfie Segmentation, and builds an adapter COMP with a clean alpha-mask Null TOP (optionally inverted and/or feathered) plus an optional pre-keyed RGBA Null TOP (person on transparent). Wire the mask into create_keyer, create_depth_silhouette, or any matte-consuming tool. The engine reuses an existing MediaPipe op if already loaded (idempotent). Keep the TD timeline PLAYING so the embedded browser captures the webcam; click Allow if macOS prompts for camera permission.

tox_path.description: Path to the MediaPipe ENGINE .tox (MediaPipe.tox). Defaults to the package staged by `tdmcp install mediapipe-touchdesigner`, falling back to the legacy ~/tdmcp-packages path.

parent_path.description: COMP to load the engine into. Reuses the existing engine if MediaPipe already exists.

model.description: Selfie-segmentation model variant. 'general' works at any orientation; 'landscape' is tuned for wide-angle scenes.

smooth.description: Enable the engine's mask temporal smoothing parameter if present.

publish_prekeyed.description: Also build a person_rgba Null TOP (camera × mask) so you can drop 'person on transparent' straight into a comp.

invert_mask.description: Output 1 − mask (useful for background-only effects). Applied via a Level TOP on the mask branch.

feather_px.description: Soft-edge blur radius on the mask before publishing (Blur TOP). 0 = hard mask.

name.description: Adapter COMP name under parent_path. Defaults to 'mp_segmentation'.

tools.name: create_hand_gesture_bus
tools.description: Create a TouchDesigner Base COMP that converts hand landmarks into a stable gesture-control Null CHOP for palm holograms, lasers, audio controls, and other hand-reactive visuals. It creates helper nodes under parent_path, returns the component/output paths and created-node report, and exposes debounced channels such as palm_open, float_x/y, palm_size, pinch_active, pinch_power, scale_target, light_gain, and audio_level. Use source='synthetic' for camera-free previews, source='mediapipe' to build/use setup_hand_tracking, or source='existing_chop' with hand_chop_path when a hand landmark CHOP already exists.

source.description: Input source: synthetic preview data, a new MediaPipe adapter, or an existing hand CHOP.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP where the gesture-bus component and helper nodes are created.

comp_name.description: Name for the created gesture-bus Base COMP under parent_path.

hand_chop_path.description: Required only when source='existing_chop'; path to a CHOP with hand landmark channels.

tox_path.description: Optional MediaPipe adapter .tox path passed through when source='mediapipe'.

adapter_name.description: Name for the setup_hand_tracking adapter when source='mediapipe'.

max_hands.description: Number of hands to track or synthesize; the gesture bus supports one or two hands.

coordinate_space.description: Coordinate family expected from the hand source: normalized image space or world space.

mirror.description: Mirror X coordinates for front-facing camera interaction and synthetic previews.

smoothing.description: Slow smoothing factor for stable palm/float channels; higher values move more slowly.

fast_smoothing.description: Fast smoothing factor for responsive pinch/power channels; higher values move more slowly.

hold_seconds.description: Seconds a disappearing/open palm is held before channels fall back.

pinch_arm_seconds.description: Seconds pinch_active must remain close before it is considered armed.

pinch_close_dist.description: Thumb-index distance at or below which a pinch closes; must be less than pinch_open_dist.

pinch_open_dist.description: Thumb-index distance at or above which a pinch opens; must be greater than pinch_close_dist.

pinch_radius.description: Palm-local radius around the pinch point used to estimate pinch_power.

pinch_radius_scale.description: Multiplier applied to pinch_radius when converting distance into pinch_power.

pinch_threshold.description: Normalized pinch_power threshold used to expose binary pinch_active channels.

active_hand_lock.description: Keep the first active hand as the control hand until it is lost, reducing hand switching.

expose_controls.description: Create custom parameters on the component for tuning smoothing, pinch, and lock behavior.

tools.name: create_hand_ableton_mapper
tools.description: Build a MediaPipe-hands to TDAbleton TDA_Mapper performance control network. It outputs map1=left pinch, map2=right pinch, map3=left wrist roll, map4=right wrist roll, creates a skeleton overlay with star joints plus the thumb-index line, and optionally relinks an existing TDA_Mapper to the generated mapper_send CHOP. Uses TDAbleton directly; AbletonMCP is not required.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP for the mapper network.

hand_chop.description: Existing hand CHOP with tx/ty/tz/confidence/handedness/screen_x/screen_y. Defaults to setup_hand_tracking's adapter output.

ensure_hand_tracking.description: When hand_chop is omitted, run setup_hand_tracking first.

tox_path.description: Optional MediaPipe.tox path forwarded to setup_hand_tracking.

adapter_name.description: Hand adapter name used by setup_hand_tracking.

coordinate_space.description: Coordinate space forwarded to setup_hand_tracking; world is best for pinch distance.

closed_distance.description: Distance where thumb/index are treated as closed.

open_distance.description: Distance where thumb/index are treated as fully open.

min_confidence.description: Minimum landmark confidence to accept a hand slot.

fallback_slots.description: If handedness is missing, treat slot 0 as left and slot 1 as right.

link_mapper.description: Try to set the TDA_Mapper Oscinputchop/Reorder/range parameters.

create_overlay.description: Create a skeleton overlay TOP with star joints and a thumb-index line.

tools.name: diagnose_tdableton_mapper
tools.description: Inspect a TouchDesigner TDAbleton mapper COMP and its source CHOP. Reports common mapper symptoms and can optionally repair Oscinputchop, Reorder, Bypass, and Min/Max parameters without requiring AbletonMCP or a live Ableton connection.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP/project used when auto-searching for a TDA_Mapper COMP.

mapper_path.description: Optional explicit path to the TDAbleton TDA_Mapper COMP.

source_chop.description: CHOP expected to drive the TDAbleton mapper.

expected_reorder.description: Expected Reorder parameter value and required source channel list.

repair.description: If true, apply best-effort mapper parameter repairs inside TouchDesigner.

tools.name: auto_repair_loop
tools.description: Driver: scan a subtree for cook errors, cluster them, route each cluster to the right fix (calls repair_network for structural/expression/flag issues; surfaces fix_shader / fix_reactivity as prompt hand-offs the agent must execute next turn), re-check, and iterate until clean, no-progress (stalled), or max_iterations (exhausted). Dry-run by default — one planning iteration, no writes. The loop CANNOT fix shaders or dead reactivity itself; it points the agent at them via recommended_prompts. Returns {status, iterations[], errors_before, errors_after, remaining[], recommended_prompts[], warnings}.

path.description: Root of the subtree to scan + repair.

max_iterations.description: Hard cap on outer iterations — each iteration = one scan + one route + one apply.

dry_run.description: When true (default), PLAN routes only (no writes). Propagated to repair_network; the loop runs exactly one iteration in dry-run mode.

allowed_fixers.description: Subset of fixers the loop may route to. Drop 'repair_network' to make the loop advisory only (prompts + remaining, no writes).

min_progress.description: Convergence threshold — if an iteration clears fewer than this many errors, the loop stops (stalled).

include_warnings.description: When true, treat 'warning' severity errors as in-scope. Default ignores warnings (no-op until the bridge surfaces severity).

tools.name: build_pop_chain
tools.description: Declarative Layer-2 builder for an ordered POP (Point OPerator) chain. Pass a `chain` list of `{ type, name?, params?, extra_inputs? }` entries; each chain[i] is wired output 0 → input 0 of chain[i+1] under `parent` (default `/project1`). Per-kind safe defaults are applied before user `params`; unknown par names become warnings (fail-forward). Multi-input POPs (merge, copy, feedback, proximity, switch, blend) accept `extra_inputs` paths wired into input 1, 2, …. POPs are Experimental — result carries `unverified` marker. Tip: end the chain in a `null_pop` for a stable handoff to Wave-3 render rigs.

parent.description: Parent COMP path (default '/project1'). Same semantic as build_chop_chain.

name.description: Base name; used as prefix for auto-named ops and as the chain id.

type.description: Curated chainable POP kind. 77 entries — see POP_KINDS.

params.description: Par overlay applied after kind defaults. String value matching an earlier op's name resolves to that op's path.

extra_inputs.description: Additional input paths for multi-input kinds (mergePOP, copyPOP, feedbackPOP, proximityPOP, switchPOP, blendPOP). Wired into input 1, 2, … in order.

chain.description: Ordered POP chain. chain[i] is wired output 0 → input 0 of chain[i+1]; extra_inputs of chain[i] are wired into input 1, 2, …

tools.name: create_audio_glsl_uniforms
tools.description: Writes CHOP-reference expressions onto the seq.vec uniform slots of an existing glslTOP, so named channels (low/mid/high/rms etc.) drive shader uniforms every cook. Creates no operators — pure parameter binding. Idempotent and composable with create_glsl_shader.

target_glsl_path.description: Path to an existing glslTOP whose seq.vec slots will be bound.

source_chop_path.description: Path to the CHOP whose channels are read (must contain every `chan` listed in bindings).

uniform.description: Uniform name as declared in the GLSL shader (e.g. 'uBass'). Written to vec<slot>name.

component.description: Which component of the vec slot the channel drives. Use multiple entries with the same slot to fill yzw.

slot.description: seq.vec slot index (0..19). If omitted, slots are assigned by uniform name — entries sharing a uniform reuse a slot; new uniforms claim the next free index starting at 0.

bindings.description: Channel → uniform/component map. Multiple entries can target the same slot (different components) to build a multi-component uniform.

expand_capacity.description: If true, grow g.seq.vec.numBlocks to fit the highest slot index. If false, an out-of-range slot is a hard error.

tools.name: connect_comfyui
tools.description: Bridge a running ComfyUI server: drops the TDComfyUI .tox if installed, otherwise builds a stock webclientDAT skeleton. The container exposes a Null TOP at <container>/out as the downstream output.

mode.description: 'auto' tries tox_drop first then falls back to webclient. Force one explicitly when you know which is installed.

parent_path.description: COMP that will receive the ComfyUI container.

tox_path.description: Explicit .tox path. When omitted, candidates are probed in order: olegchomp/TDComfyUI, JiSenHua/ComfyUI-TD.

server_url.description: ComfyUI server base URL — host:port of `python main.py --listen`.

workflow_json_path.description: Absolute path to a ComfyUI workflow JSON exported from the web UI (Save (API Format)). Required for webclient mode.

source_top_path.description: (webclient) TOP whose current frame is sent as the workflow input image via Syphon/Spout re-broadcast.

output_top_name.description: Name of the Null TOP exposed inside the container as the downstream output.

output_mode.description: How the generated frame is pulled back into TD. 'file_watch' reloads ComfyUI's output folder via a movieFileInTOP.

output_source_name.description: Spout sender / Syphon server / NDI source name to receive on. Must match the ComfyUI side.

watch_folder.description: (output_mode=file_watch) Folder ComfyUI writes outputs to. The movieFileInTOP cycles the newest file.

poll_interval_seconds.description: (webclient) How often to poll /history for completion.

active.description: Start polling / streaming immediately. Default off so the artist can sanity-check first.

tools.name: connect_daydream_cloud
tools.description: Create a Daydream cloud-hosted StreamDiffusion bridge in TD. A webclientDAT POSTs the encoded source TOP frame to Daydream's REST endpoint; the diffused result is pulled back via a Syphon/Spout/NDI receiver and exposed as a null TOP. API key is read from DAYDREAM_API_KEY in the TD process environment — never inlined. Live probe SKIPPED (requires Daydream account + outbound HTTPS).

parent_path.description: COMP to create the bridge sub-network in.

source_top_path.description: TOP whose frames are POSTed to Daydream.

server_url.description: Daydream inference endpoint. Override for self-hosted or staging.

prompt.description: Text prompt sent in the request body.

fps.description: Outbound POST cadence; clamped 1–30 (cloud rate-limit guard).

output_mode.description: Receiver TOP to instantiate for the relay output.

output_source_name.description: NDI source / Syphon-Spout sender name to subscribe to.

active.description: Start polling immediately (default off so artist can confirm API key is set).

expose_controls.description: Add custom-page sliders (Prompt, Strength, FPS, Active).

tools.name: create_llm_chain
tools.description: Stand up a prompt → response LLM chain inside TouchDesigner as a self-contained baseCOMP. Two modes: webclient — stock chain using webclientDAT + textDATs + headers tableDAT that POSTs JSON to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, OpenRouter). tox_drop — drops the dotsimulate LLM LOPs .tox and wires mirror DATs. Default provider=ollama (fully offline, no key). API keys are read from env inside TouchDesigner (os.environ) and written into a headers tableDAT — the MCP server never sees them. Returns container_path, prompt_dat_path, response_dat_path, status_chan (:busy), provider, model, endpoint_url, and missing_env when a key is needed but unset. Notes: webclientDAT uses `reqmethod`/`url`/`includeheader` (verified live TD 099); body content goes via body_builder textDAT + callbacks. Anthropic uses x-api-key header + anthropic-version, not Authorization; Ollama requires ollama serve running on 127.0.0.1:11434; dotsimulate TOX par names are UNVERIFIED.

mode.description: webclient: stock chain via webclientDAT — no extra dependencies, works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. tox_drop: drops the dotsimulate LLM LOPs .tox (requires the TOX installed locally).

parent_path.description: COMP path to build inside.

name.description: Inner baseCOMP name. Defaults to llm_<provider> (webclient) or llm_chain (tox_drop).

provider.description: LLM provider. ollama default — works fully offline, no API key required. custom requires endpoint_url and model.

endpoint_url.description: Override the endpoint URL. Required for provider=custom. Defaults: openai → https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions, anthropic → https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages, ollama → http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1/chat/completions.

model.description: Model name. Required for provider=custom. Defaults: openai → gpt-4o-mini, anthropic → claude-sonnet-4-5, ollama → llama3.2.

system_prompt.default: You are a concise creative assistant for a TouchDesigner live show.
system_prompt.description: Written into a hidden sys textDAT.

initial_prompt.description: Seeds the Prompt textDAT on creation.

json_mode.description: Set response_format={type:json_object} for openai/ollama compatible endpoints. Ignored for anthropic.

auto_request.description: If true, a datExecuteDAT fires webclient.request() whenever the prompt textDAT changes. Default false — caller drives.

tox_path.description: Path to the dotsimulate LLM TOX. Required for mode=tox_drop. Also probes Library/LLM.tox and tox/LLM.tox.

expose_controls.description: Surface Send (Pulse), Model, Temperature, MaxTokens, Active, JsonMode, Provider on the wrapper.

tools.name: add_timecode_overlay
tools.description: Overlay a running HH:MM:SS:FF timecode (or a countdown) onto an input TOP as VISUAL pixels — a Text TOP whose text expression re-evaluates every frame, composited 'over' the source with a Composite TOP. Modes: clock (show time since project start — NOT the OS wall clock — as HH:MM:SS:FF), count_up (elapsed time since this overlay was built, from zero), count_down (counts down from `target_seconds` to 00:00:00:00 and clamps there). The formatter lives in a Text DAT module (mod('fmt').tc(...)) so it re-cooks live inside TD. FPS is probed live (me.time.rate -> project.cookRate -> 60 fallback) and reported. Distinct from sync_timecode, which syncs a CLOCK SIGNAL (no pixels) — this tool draws the timecode into the image. Ends with a Null TOP 'out'.

source_top.description: Path of the input TOP to overlay the timecode onto (e.g. '/project1/moviefilein1'). REQUIRED.

mode.description: clock: show total show time (since project start) as HH:MM:SS:FF. count_up: elapsed time since this overlay was built, from 00:00:00:00. count_down: counts down from `target_seconds` to 00:00:00:00 and clamps there.

target_seconds.description: count_down only: seconds to count down from. Ignored in clock/count_up modes.

color.description: Timecode text color as a hex string, e.g. '#ff3366'.

position.description: Where the timecode text is anchored over the source frame.

parent_path.description: Where to build the overlay chain (a COMP path, e.g. '/project1').

name.description: Base name for the container COMP that holds the chain.

tools.name: create_feedback_network
tools.description: Build a feedback-based visual system: a seed feeds a loop that is transformed (blur/displace/etc.) and fed back each frame. Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path` holding the seed, a Feedback TOP, a 'maximum' Composite, the transform chain, a Level decay node, an optional GLSL colorize pass, and a Null output (the Feedback TOP samples the Level node to close the loop). Great for evolving, hypnotic visuals. Exposes a live 'Feedback' decay knob. Returns a summary plus a JSON block with the container path, created node paths, the output path, exposed controls, any node errors, warnings, and an inline preview image. Use this for a general feedback look with a chosen seed type and an ordered chain of effects; for the specific infinite-zoom/rotate spiral (with Zoom/Rotate/HueShift/Decay knobs) use create_feedback_tunnel instead.

seed_type.description: What feeds the loop each frame: 'noise' (monochrome Noise TOP), 'shape' (Circle TOP), 'image'/'video' (Movie File In TOP), 'webcam' (Video Device In TOP — may prompt for camera permission), or 'glsl' (a generative shader). Default 'noise'.

transformations.description: TOP effects applied in order inside the loop each frame (blur, displace, edge, level, hsv_adjust, transform, mirror, tile, luma_blur). Default ['blur','displace','level'].

feedback_gain.description: Loop decay multiplier (0–1) applied via a Level TOP's brightness1: how much of the fed-back frame survives each cycle. Higher = longer-lived, more saturated trails; default 0.95.

colors.description: Up to two hex colors ('#rrggbb') used to colorize the otherwise-grayscale output via a final GLSL gradient (one color = black→color, two = color0→color1). Omit to leave it grayscale.

expose_controls.description: When true (default), expose a live 'Feedback' knob on the system container, bound to the loop's decay.

parent_path.description: Parent network where the feedback container is created (default '/project1').

tools.name: create_generative_art
tools.description: Create an evolving generative visual. Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path` holding the generator (a recipe network, a GLSL TOP + Text DAT, or a noise chain) ending in a Null output. reaction_diffusion/noise_landscape use validated recipes; strange_attractor, voronoi, and fractal render built-in GLSL; custom_glsl accepts caller shader source only when TDMCP_RAW_PYTHON=on and TDMCP_BRIDGE_ALLOW_EXEC=1; the rest fall back to animated noise (with a warning). Exposes a live 'Speed' knob (except for recipe-built techniques). Returns a summary plus a JSON block with the container path, created node paths, the output path, exposed controls, the technique, any node errors, warnings, and an inline preview image.

technique.description: Generative method. reaction_diffusion/noise_landscape build validated recipes; strange_attractor/voronoi/fractal render faithful inline GLSL; custom_glsl uses your shader (custom_glsl_code); l_system/cellular_automata/flow_field currently fall back to an animated-noise approximation (with a warning).

color_palette.description: Free-text palette hint recorded in the result; best-effort, not all techniques honor it.

evolution_speed.description: Animation speed multiplier on the time uniform driving the look (1 = nominal, higher = faster evolution). Exposed as the 'Speed' knob.

custom_glsl_code.description: Fragment shader source used only when technique='custom_glsl'; if omitted, a default plasma shader is used (with a warning).

expose_controls.description: When true (default), expose a live 'Speed' knob (evolution speed) on the system container.

parent_path.description: Parent network where the generative container is created (default '/project1').

tools.name: create_audio_reactive
tools.description: Build an audio analysis chain (spectrum + level + optional beat) and a spectrum visual driven by it. Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path` holding the audio source, an Audio Spectrum CHOP, an Analyze level, an optional Beat CHOP, a CHOP-to-TOP texture with a Sensitivity gain, the GLSL visual, and a Null output. Each visual_style renders the spectrum its own way: glsl=horizontal bars, geometric=radial bars, particle=dot field, feedback=ring tunnel, instancing=LED grid. Returns a summary plus a JSON block with the container path, created node paths, the output path, exposed controls, any node errors, warnings, and an inline preview image. This is the only audio tool that produces a built-in visual: use extract_audio_features for level/bass/mid/treble channels or create_spectrum for per-band channels (no visual), and bind_audio_reactive to wire those channels onto an existing COMP's knobs.

audio_source.description: Where audio comes from: 'microphone'/'device_in' create an Audio Device In CHOP, 'file' an Audio File In CHOP (set audio_file_path), 'existing_chop' reuses an audio CHOP you already have (set existing_chop_path).

audio_file_path.description: Path to an audio file to play; used only when audio_source='file'.

existing_chop_path.description: Path of an existing audio CHOP to analyze; used only when audio_source='existing_chop'.

visual_style.description: How the spectrum is rendered: glsl=horizontal bars, geometric=radial bars, particle=dot field, feedback=ring tunnel, instancing=LED grid.

frequency_bands.description: Spectrum resolution: sets the Audio Spectrum CHOP output length (TouchDesigner clamps it to 128–4096 bins). Higher = finer spectrum.

beat_detection.description: When true (default), add a Beat CHOP driven by the audio source for tempo/beat signals.

expose_controls.description: When true (default), expose a live 'Sensitivity' knob controlling how strongly the audio drives the visual.

parent_path.description: Parent network where the audio-reactive container is created (default '/project1').

transient_gate.description: When true, add a transient/onset channel to a new modulation Null CHOP (`mod1`) for binding to parameters.

transient_threshold.description: Transient threshold (0–1); used only when transient_gate=true.

transient_hold_ms.description: Transient hold time in ms before decay; used only when transient_gate=true.

sidechain_duck.description: When true, add an inverted duck-envelope channel to the modulation Null CHOP (`mod1`).

duck_depth.description: How deeply the duck pulls toward 0 at peak level (0–1).

duck_release_ms.description: Release time of the duck envelope in ms.

tools.name: create_particle_system
tools.description: Build a CPU particle system: an emitter SOP feeds a Particle SOP inside a Geometry COMP, rendered with a camera + light. Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path` holding the Geometry COMP (emitter + particle SOP), a material, Camera, Light, Render TOP, and a Null output. Forces and render style are scaffolded for further tuning. Exposes live Drag / Turbulence / Gravity / Lifetime knobs. This is the simplest CPU emitter, born from a real SOP shape; pick a sibling instead when you need scale or specific motion: create_gpu_particle_field for much higher counts (GPU-simulated noise/curl/gravity drift, up to ~262k), create_particle_flock for boids/flocking behaviour, image_to_particles to reconstruct an image/video as points, create_pop_particle_system for TouchDesigner's native POP particle network. Returns a summary plus a JSON block with the container path, created node paths, the output path, exposed controls, any node errors, warnings (e.g. approximated forces or fallback render styles), and an inline preview image.

emitter_shape.description: Source SOP particles are born from: point (Add SOP), line, circle, sphere, mesh (Box), or image (Grid). Default 'sphere' — its varied normals spray a full radial cloud; 'point' has no normals and stays a thin turbulence-driven stream.

particle_count.description: Target number of live particles at steady state; sets the Particle SOP birth rate (birth ≈ count / lifetime). Default 10000.

forces.description: Forces applied to the sim, mapped to native Particle SOP params (gravity→external -Y, noise/turbulence→turbulence, drag→drag). attract/repel/vortex have no native equivalent and are approximated with turbulence (a warning is returned). Default ['noise','gravity'].

render_style.description: How particles are drawn. 'sprites' uses a Point Sprite MAT, 'points' a Constant MAT; 'lines'/'trails'/'instanced_geo' currently fall back to point/sprite rendering (a warning is returned). Default 'sprites'.

lifetime.description: Particle life span in seconds before it dies and is reborn. Default 3.

expose_controls.description: When true (default), expose live Drag / Turbulence / Gravity / Lifetime knobs on the system container.

parent_path.description: Parent network where the particle-system container is created (default '/project1').

tools.name: create_data_visualization
tools.description: Build a data-driven visualization: a data source feeds a CHOP that drives a chart TOP. Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path` holding a 'data' source operator (seeded with placeholder values), a DAT-to-CHOP / CHOP-to-TOP conversion, a Scale level, the chart visual, and a Null output. Wire your real data into the created 'data' node. Returns a summary plus a JSON block with the container path, created node paths, the output path, exposed controls, any node errors, warnings (including a reminder to wire real data), and an inline preview image.

data_source.description: Kind of source operator to create: 'table' (Table DAT, pre-seeded with sample values), 'file' (File In DAT), or 'chop' (Constant CHOP). Wire your real data into the created 'data' node afterward.

chart_style.description: Visual style. 'bars' renders a GLSL bar chart; 'graph' and 'points' currently render the data as a texture strip and add a warning that richer plotting needs customization.

expose_controls.description: When true (default), expose a live 'Scale' knob that amplifies the data values feeding the chart.

parent_path.description: Parent network where the visualization container is created (default '/project1').

tools.name: apply_post_processing
tools.description: Chain post-processing effects (bloom, glitch, rgb_split, vignette, etc.) onto an existing TOP, applied in the order given. Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path` that pulls the source in via a Select TOP, wires each effect (built-in TOPs or inline-GLSL passes) in series, and ends in a Null TOP. Returns a summary plus a JSON block with the container path, all created node paths, the output Null path, any node errors, warnings, and an inline preview image. Use create_color_grade or create_glitch instead when you want a single dedicated effect with its own exposed controls.

source_path.description: Path of the existing TOP to post-process (e.g. '/project1/render1'); pulled in via a Select TOP so it may live in another container.

effects.description: Effects to apply, chained in the order listed. Each is one of: bloom, chromatic_aberration, film_grain, vignette, color_grade, sharpen, blur, edge_detect, invert, threshold, posterize, glitch, rgb_split, scanlines, halftone, dither, crt, mirror, vhs, npr_oil, npr_pencil, npr_watercolor. The 3D-aware modes ssao / ssr / dof / motion_blur are recognized but redirect to the dedicated `post_passes_3d` tool (they need depth/normal/velocity AOVs that this chain doesn't have).

parent_path.description: Parent network where the effect-chain container is created (default '/project1').

tools.name: setup_output
tools.description: Route a finished TOP to an output destination: a display window, NDI stream, Syphon/Spout, a recording, or Touch Out. Creates the matching output node ('<output_type>_out') under parent_path; for a window it points the Window COMP's winop at the source and sets its size, and for the other types it bridges the source in through a Select TOP (TD wires can't cross COMP boundaries). Typically the LAST step after building a visual — feed it the output Null from a create_* tool or a create_layer_mixer. Returns the created output node path, the output type, the source path, and any non-fatal warnings (e.g. if wiring or window config failed).

source_path.description: Path of the final TOP to output.

output_type.description: Destination: 'window' (a Window COMP display), 'ndi' (NDI Out TOP network stream), 'syphon_spout' (Syphon/Spout Out TOP for other apps), 'record' (Movie File Out TOP to disk), or 'touch_out' (Touch Out TOP to another TD instance).

resolution.description: Window size for output_type='window' (720p=1280×720, 1080p=1920×1080, 4K=3840×2160); ignored by the other output types.

record_format.description: File format for output_type='record' (sets the Movie File Out TOP's type); ignored otherwise.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the output node (and any bridging Select TOP) is created inside.

tools.name: get_preview
tools.description: Capture a TOP node's current output as an inline PNG image. This is read-only. The bridge may return the TOP's native output dimensions instead of the requested width×height; when they differ, the caption shows both. Only TOPs can be previewed (CHOP/SOP/etc. have no image). For a cheaper check of activity and approximate colour, pass sample_grid=N to return an N×N grid of RGBA samples and per-channel statistics instead of an image.

node_path.description: Path of the TOP node to capture. Required unless collecting a deferred job by job_id.

width.description: Requested preview width (1–4096; default 640). The bridge may return a TOP's native output width; when it differs, the caption reports both native and requested sizes.

height.description: Requested preview height (1–4096; default 360). The bridge may return a TOP's native output height; when it differs, the caption reports both native and requested sizes.

sample_grid.description: When set (2–16), return a lightweight N×N grid of RGBA samples + per-channel min/max/mean as JSON instead of an image — 10–50× cheaper. Use this when you only need to know whether the output is alive / roughly what colour it is, not its spatial detail.

pre_pulses.description: Parameters to pulse in the SAME frame immediately before capturing — e.g. reset a feedback loop or fire a timer so a transient is actually visible. All targets are validated before any fires (all-or-nothing).

delay_frames.description: Defer the capture by N frames (to catch an event that appears a few frames after a pulse). Returns a job_id + wait_ms instead of the image; call get_preview again with that job_id to collect the result.

job_id.description: Collect a previously deferred capture (from a delay_frames call) by its job_id.

tools.name: plan_visual
tools.description: Turn a visual description into a read-only build plan. The deterministic planner remains the default and creates nothing. Set planner='llm' to opt into one bounded completion grounded in compact editor/project/recipe/operator evidence; every suggested tool, recipe and operator is validated, and any unavailable or invalid LLM path falls back deterministically without mutating TouchDesigner.

description.description: Natural-language description of the visual you want.

planner.description: Use the deterministic keyword planner (default), or explicitly request one bounded, grounded LLM completion with deterministic fallback.

root_path.description: Optional TouchDesigner root used only for bounded read-only grounding in planner='llm'.

llm_timeout_ms.description: Bound the single LLM completion to 1000-10000 ms.

tools.name: create_visual_system
tools.description: Create a complete visual system from a natural-language description. Classifies intent (audio-reactive, particle, feedback, reaction-diffusion, landscape, generative) and delegates to the matching Layer-1 builder (or a tag-matched recipe), creating a self-contained COMP under parent_path, then verifies and previews it. Use plan_visual instead for a dry run that reports which tool/recipe would be chosen without building anything. Returns a note on how the description was interpreted plus the underlying builder's result (created nodes, exposed controls, and a preview image).

description.description: Natural-language description of the visual system.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the generated visual-system container is created inside.

resolution.description: Advisory target resolution. Recorded in the build note; the sub-builders use their own internal sizes and do not enforce this per-node.

target_fps.description: Advisory target frame rate (informational only — TD's real cook rate is a project-level setting, not set here).

tools.name: extract_audio_features
tools.description: Build an audio-analysis chain that exposes ready-to-bind reactive channels — overall level plus bass/mid/treble band energies — on a Null CHOP. Unlike create_audio_reactive (which renders a spectrum visual), this produces the raw signals so you can drive ANY parameter: bind a node parameter to op('…/audio_features/features')['bass'] and it pulses with the music. A Sensitivity knob scales all channels. Source can be the live device (mic/line — may prompt for macOS permission), an audio file, a synthetic oscillator (for testing), or an existing CHOP. Use create_spectrum for N fine per-band channels instead of these four coarse bands, and pass this Null as the source_chop to bind_audio_reactive to make a whole COMP react.

source.description: Audio source. 'device' = live microphone/line in (the real-world default; creating it may pop a one-time macOS microphone-permission dialog — click Allow). 'file' = an audio file. 'oscillator' = a synthetic tone, handy for testing without any device permission. 'existing_chop' = reuse a CHOP you already have.

existing_chop_path.description: Path of an existing audio CHOP to analyze (source='existing_chop').

bass_hz.description: Low-pass cutoff for the bass band.

mid_hz.description: Band-pass centre for the mid band.

treble_hz.description: High-pass cutoff for the treble band.

expose_controls.description: Expose a live 'Sensitivity' knob (a gain over every feature channel).

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the self-contained 'audio_features' container is created inside.

tools.name: create_motion_reactive
tools.description: Build a video-analysis chain that exposes ready-to-bind reactive channels — overall brightness plus frame-to-frame motion energy — on a Null CHOP. The camera counterpart to extract_audio_features: bind any parameter to op('…/motion_reactive/features')['motion'] and it responds to movement in front of the camera, or ['brightness'] to ambient light. A Sensitivity knob scales both. Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path` holding the source, a downsized monochrome analysis chain, and a 'features' Null CHOP output. Source can be the live camera (may prompt for macOS permission), a movie file, an animated synthetic pattern (for testing without a camera), or an existing TOP. Optical flow is unavailable on macOS, so direction isn't exposed. Returns a summary plus a JSON block with the container path, created node paths, the features Null path, the channel names, exposed controls, any node errors, and warnings (no preview image — the output is a CHOP, not a TOP).

source.description: Video source. 'camera' = live webcam/capture device (the real-world default; creating it may pop a one-time macOS camera-permission dialog — click Allow). 'file' = a movie file. 'synthetic' = an animated noise pattern, handy for testing without any device permission. 'existing_top' = analyze a TOP you already have.

movie_file_path.description: Path to a movie file to play as the source; used only when source='file'.

existing_top_path.description: Path of an existing TOP to analyze; used only when source='existing_top'.

analysis_resolution.description: The video is downsized to this square resolution before analysis — small keeps it cheap (the reactive values barely change with size).

expose_controls.description: When true (default), expose a live 'Sensitivity' knob (a gain over every feature channel).

parent_path.description: Parent network where the motion-reactive container is created (default '/project1').

tools.name: create_interactive_projection_mapping
tools.description: Build a synthetic-safe interactive projection mapping rig for a USB webcam plus projector: camera/synthetic/existing TOP input, frame-difference motion field, placeholder blob/post-it mask, cyan dot and magenta card visual TOPs, manual Corner Pin projection mapping, debug switch, live controls, and an out1 Null TOP. Defaults to source='camera' for installations, but source='synthetic' previews without camera permission. Returns output/debug paths and explicit warnings for camera, blob tracking, and physical calibration states.

name.description: Name for the generated interactive projection mapping Base COMP.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP where the interactive projection mapping system is created.

source.description: Input source: a USB camera, a self-animated synthetic TOP, or an existing TOP pulled through a Select TOP.

existing_top_path.description: Absolute TOP path required when source='existing_top'.

camera_index.description: USB/webcam device index used when source='camera'.

fallback_to_synthetic.description: If camera creation fails, build a synthetic source so the rig remains previewable.

interaction_mode.description: Interaction branch to prioritize. The first slice always keeps motion available.

analysis_resolution.description: Square working resolution for cheap motion/blob analysis.

particle_count.description: Target count for the cyan dot field. This MVP uses it as visual density metadata.

card_count.description: Target count for magenta card blocks. This MVP uses it as visual density metadata.

motion_sensitivity.description: Gain over the frame-difference motion field.

repel_radius.description: Normalized radius metadata for hand/motion repulsion.

blob_threshold.description: Threshold used by the placeholder blob/post-it mask branch.

max_blobs.description: Maximum blob slots reserved for the later marker-tracking branch.

projection_brightness.description: Final Level TOP brightness before out1.

debug_view.description: Which branch the debug switch shows initially.

expose_controls.description: Expose live controls for calibration/debug/performance tuning.

tools.name: create_kinect_wall_harp
tools.description: Build a synthetic-safe Kinect v2 / FreenectTD projected wall harp in an isolated Base COMP. The network can create a FreenectTOP depth path when explicitly enabled, listen to an external OSC Kinect bridge with source='osc_kinect', or build a synthetic fallback. It extracts left/right hand centroids, divides the projection into configurable musical zones, triggers short electronic plucks on zone entry, renders a denser vibrating curtain of projected strings, and exposes depth/mask/hands/audio plus bridge-status diagnostics. If FreenectTD or Kinect hardware is unavailable, the tool returns warnings instead of throwing, so the visual/audio/trigger chain can still be tested offline.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path where the isolated kinect_wall_harp Base COMP is created.

name.description: Name for the generated Base COMP under parent_path.

source.description: Input source. 'freenect' tries the FreenectTD FreenectTOP Kinect v2 path; 'synthetic' builds a device-free wall-touch simulator; 'osc_kinect' listens for normalized Kinect hand points from an external OSC bridge.

osc_port.description: UDP port for OSC Kinect hand input when source='osc_kinect'.

bridge_status_json.description: JSON status path written by scripts/kinect-wall-harp-bridge.mjs --status-json and read by the generated bridge_status DAT.

fallback_to_synthetic.description: When true, missing FreenectTD/Kinect hardware still creates a playable synthetic fallback with warnings.

deactivate_existing_freenect.description: Deactivate existing FreenectTOP nodes under parent_path before starting the new Kinect source. Kinect v2 is a single-device path, so this avoids multiple active FreenectTD nodes competing for the same sensor.

activate_freenect.description: Safety gate for actually creating/activating FreenectTOP. Default false because FreenectTD Kinect v2 initialization is unstable on the validated macOS setup; leave false for crash-safe synthetic fallback.

output_width.description: Width for generated debug and projected output TOPs.

output_height.description: Height for generated debug and projected output TOPs.

wall_depth_center.description: Normalized depth value representing the calibrated wall/touch plane.

depth_polarity.description: Which side of the wall-depth band should count as touch candidates.

sensitivity.description: Blob threshold / cleanup aggressiveness for the wall-touch mask.

smoothing.description: Hand centroid smoothing amount used by the tracking Script CHOP.

input_mirror_x.description: Mirror normalized hand X after OSC input, before projector-space calibration.

input_left.description: Raw normalized Kinect X that maps to the projector's left edge.

input_right.description: Raw normalized Kinect X that maps to the projector's right edge.

input_top.description: Raw normalized Kinect Y that maps to the projector's top edge.

input_bottom.description: Raw normalized Kinect Y that maps to the projector's bottom edge.

show_debug.description: When true, the visual Script TOP draws hand dots and zone guides.

calibration_hold_ms.description: Milliseconds a hand must remain stable on a calibration target before auto-capture.

string_count.description: Number of musical trigger zones across the projected wall harp.

visual_line_count.description: Number of visible projected laser lines. Can exceed string_count for curtain behavior.

curtain_spread.description: How many neighboring visual lines share vibration from each musical zone.

curtain_follow.description: How strongly nearby visual lines bend around tracked wall-touch hands.

frequencies.description: Pluck frequencies for the musical trigger zones.

master_volume.description: Overall gain for the internal pluck Script CHOP.

audio_device.description: Optional Audio Device Out device name. Leave empty to keep TouchDesigner's default device.

audio_sample_rate.description: Script CHOP audio sample rate. Set to 192000 when using UMC202HD at 192k.

brightness.description: Very subtle harmonic color for the generated sine pluck tone.

reverb_mix.description: Wet reverb mix for the internal pluck synth.

reverb_decay.description: Feedback decay for the internal algorithmic reverb.

reverb_damping.description: High-frequency damping for the internal algorithmic reverb.
