Exposes Mix, Threshold, and Scale knobs for live tweaking. Returns a summary, node paths, exposed controls, and an inline preview image.

name.description: Base name for the created container.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the dither container is created inside.

source.description: Absolute path of an existing TOP to dither (e.g. '/project1/movie1'). Pulled in via a Select TOP. If omitted, a self-contained animated colour-noise source is used (no device permissions).

pattern.description: Threshold pattern. bayer2/4/8: ordered Bayer matrices (2×2/4×4/8×8); checker: alternating grid; noise: pseudo-random hash; error_diffusion: single-pass 3×3 neighbourhood approximation.

bits.description: Bit depth per channel: 1=2 levels, 2=4 levels, 4=16 levels.

palette_mode.description: mono: luminance → low/high colour. duotone: same with hue tint. rgb: quantise each channel independently using bits.

low_color.description: Off/dark palette colour [r,g,b] 0–1. Used in mono and duotone modes.

threshold.description: Threshold bias applied on top of the pattern.

scale.description: Pattern scale in pixels — larger = chunkier dither.

mix.description: Blend between original (0) and dithered output (1). Live-tweakable.

resolution.description: Output resolution [width, height] in pixels.

tools.name: create_jfa_voronoi
tools.description: Instantiate a self-contained Jump-Flooding-Algorithm Voronoi generator (stained-glass / cell pattern) as GLSL TOPs — seeds → jfa_init → K halving passes → color_pass → null. Exposes live PaletteMode / SeedCount / Speed / Jitter / EdgeThickness / EdgeColor / ColorA / ColorB controls and previews the output TOP. Pass count auto-derives from resolution (log2(max(w,h))); override with step_count.

seed_count.description: Number of Voronoi seeds (4..512). Drives the seed TOP width (next pow-2).

speed.description: Animation speed multiplier driving uTime drift of seeds. Live 'Speed' control.

palette_mode.description: random = HSV per seed; duotone = mix(ColorA, ColorB); from_image = sample image.

palette_image.description: Op path to a TOP sampled at seed UVs when palette_mode='from_image'.

edge_thickness.description: Cell border width in UV units (0..0.05). Live 'EdgeThickness' control.

edge_color.description: Border colour as hex (e.g. '#000000'). Live 'EdgeColor' RGB swatch.

jitter.description: Per-seed drift amplitude (0 = static lattice). Live 'Jitter' control.

resolution.description: Output resolution [width, height]; JFA pass count auto-derived from max axis.

step_count.description: Manual JFA pass count (0 = auto = ceil(log2(max(w,h)))).

expose_controls.description: Expose live PaletteMode/SeedCount/Speed/Jitter/EdgeThickness/EdgeColor/ColorA/ColorB.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path; container 'jfa_voronoi' is created inside.

tools.name: setup_tdableton
tools.description: Wire up an Ableton Live bridge inside a tdmcp-managed container. Auto mode probes for the official TDAbleton Palette COMP; if found, clones it and surfaces tempo/beat/track/device channels as binding-ready Null CHOPs. Falls back to a full OSC fabric (oscinCHOP + selectCHOP fan-out) if the Palette isn't available. Either branch exposes the same Null CHOP names at the container boundary so downstream bind_to_channel calls work regardless of which path was taken.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP to host the container (default '/project1').

mode.description: Bridge mode. 'auto' = probe palette then fall back to OSC. 'palette' = require Palette (warn on miss, still builds OSC fallback). 'osc' = skip palette probe entirely.

host.description: Ableton host IP for the OSC Out CHOP.

port_in.description: UDP port TD listens on (Live → TD).

port_out.description: UDP port TD sends to (TD → Live).

track_count.description: Number of /live/track/<i>/volume channels to materialise as bind-ready Nulls.

expose_devices.description: If true, generate /live/track/<i>/device/<j>/parameter/<k> listener rows up to device_param_count.

device_param_count.description: Per-track device-param count to materialise (used only when expose_devices).

include_tempo.description: Add Null CHOPs for tempo, beat, and bar.

tools.name: create_chop_recorder
tools.description: Build a CHOP recorder/player container that captures a source CHOP's channels over a fixed window using a Trail CHOP, snapshots the trail into a Table DAT on Stop, and plays the take back via a Datto CHOP indexed by a Timer CHOP–driven Lookup CHOP, terminating on a Null CHOP ready for bind_to_channel. Re-entrant: re-running with the same name updates controls without rebuilding. The last take is persisted in comp.store so it survives a .toe reload. Large takes (nchan × samples > 250k) are saved to disk instead of stored in the .toe. Note: time-dependent playback reads 0 when the TD timeline is paused — that is expected behavior.

lengthSeconds.description: Trail window + take duration in seconds (0.25–120)

loop.description: When true, timer cycles; when false, plays once then holds

recordOnCreate.description: If true, sets Record=1 on creation so the trail begins filling immediately

autoBind.description: Optional 'opPath:parName' to auto-bind the Null CHOP output channel

tools.name: create_video_scopes
tools.description: Build a broadcast-style video engineering monitor with multiple scope panels: waveform (luma trace), RGB parade (per-channel traces), and vectorscope (UV chrominance scatter). Each panel renders as a CHOP-to-SOP scope line through an orthographic camera and Render TOP, composited into a single output TOP via layoutTOP. Companion to create_waveform (audio) and create_spectrum (audio frequency). Default source is a synthetic test pattern (no device permission needed); 'device' is opt-in for live camera. The histogram panel here is unsupported in TD 099 and silently skipped — for a working luminance/RGB histogram use the standalone create_histogram_scope instead.

source.description: Video source. 'test_pattern' = synthetic Banana.tif (no permission needed). 'existing_top' = reuse a TOP you already have (provide existing_top_path). 'file' = a video/image file. 'device' = live camera (videodeviceinTOP) — may hang TD on a macOS permission modal.

existing_top_path.description: Path of an existing TOP to scope (source='existing_top').

enable_histogram.description: Show the luma histogram panel. Currently unsupported — TD 099 has no histogramCHOP (only histogramPOP). Pass true is accepted but the panel is silently skipped; re-enable once analyzeTOP histogram mode is confirmed.

layout.description: How enabled panels arrange in the output composite.

panel_resolution.description: Each scope panel's square side in pixels.

trace_color.description: Phosphor colour for scope lines as a hex string.

expose_controls.description: Bind live controls: Gain, TraceColor, panel-enable toggles.

gain.description: Pre-scope luma gain — zooms the trace vertically (Level TOP brightness1).

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path; the scopes container is created as 'video_scopes' inside it.

tools.name: create_sdf_field
tools.description: Build a programmable signed-distance-field (SDF) raymarcher in TouchDesigner as a self-contained GLSL TOP. Compose a CSG tree of sphere / box / torus primitives with union / intersect / subtract boolean ops and optional smooth blending. Exposes live CameraZ / Speed / StepCount / Intensity / Rotate / ColorA / ColorB / Background controls and previews the output.

primitives.description: CSG tree of SDF primitives (max 16). First prim is always union (root). Each subsequent prim is combined with the running fold via its op.

op.description: Boolean CSG op vs the running fold. First primitive's op is always treated as union.

size3.description: Per-axis half-extents [x,y,z] for box (overrides size when provided).

thickness.description: Tube radius for torus (inner radius); outer radius = size.

blend.description: Smooth blend radius [0..1]. 0 = hard boolean; >0 enables smin/smax.

camera_z.description: Camera distance from origin (uCameraZ). Live 'CameraZ' control.

camera_target.description: Look-at point baked as GLSL constant (not a live control).

speed.description: Animation speed multiplier (drives uTime). Live 'Speed' control.

step_count.description: Raymarch iterations (uSteps); SDF CSG benefits from more steps. Live 'StepCount'.

light_direction.description: Light direction normalised in shader — baked as GLSL constant.

color_a.description: Near colour hex (e.g. '#33ccff'). Live RGB swatch 'ColorA'.

color_b.description: Far colour hex (e.g. '#ff2266'). Live RGB swatch 'ColorB'.

background.description: Background / miss colour hex. Live RGB swatch 'Background'.

rotate_scene.description: Y-axis rotation speed (radians/s applied to SDF space via uRotate * uTime). Live 'Rotate'. Reads 0 when TD timeline is paused.

resolution.description: Output resolution [width, height] of the GLSL TOP.

expose_controls.description: Expose live CameraZ/Speed/StepCount/Intensity/Rotate/ColorA/ColorB/Background controls.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the self-contained 'sdf_field' container is created inside.

tools.name: create_strange_attractor
tools.description: Build a strange-attractor deferred geometry generator: a Script CHOP integrates a chosen ODE system (Lorenz / Aizawa / Halvorsen) with configurable sub-steps and maintains a rolling ring buffer of trail_length points. A Script SOP converts the channels into one open polyline; an optional Tube SOP thickens it for shaded render inside a Geometry COMP + Camera + Light + Render TOP pipeline. Closing Roadmap Milestone 4. Complements create_growth_system (L-systems) and create_particle_flock (boids) as the deterministic CPU-geometry idiom. With TD timeline paused the integrator pauses too (time-dependent) — resume playback to continue. Returns a summary plus a JSON block with the container path, output path, exposed controls, errors, warnings, and an inline preview.

parent.description: Parent network where the container is created.

attractor.description: ODE system to integrate: lorenz (classic butterfly), aizawa, or halvorsen.

trail_length.description: Points retained in the rolling ring buffer. Higher = longer ribbon, costlier SOP cook.

steps_per_frame.description: RK-style integration sub-steps per cook frame (controls speed and smoothness).

dt.description: Integrator time step. Smaller = smoother but slower trajectory.

seed.description: Initial state [x, y, z]. A tiny non-zero offset avoids the Lorenz fixed-point stall at the origin.

params.description: Override ODE constants. Lorenz: sigma, rho, beta. Aizawa: a, b, c, d, e, f. Halvorsen: a. Unknown keys are ignored.

thickness.description: Tube SOP radius. Set to 0 to render the raw polyline (no Tube SOP — lighter on GPU).

auto_frame.description: Auto-position camera based on attractor bounding radius (deterministic; no live bound query).

expose_controls.description: Expose StepsPerFrame / Dt / TrailLength / Thickness as custom parameters on the container.

tools.name: create_optical_flow
tools.description: Build a CPU motion-energy field from a video source (cheap drop-in for displacement / particle chains; NOT a real dense optical-flow solver). Output is a single-channel TOP: bright = motion, mid-grey = still, computed as `gain × (current − previous luminance) + 0.5`. In direction_from='edges' mode the result is multiplied by a Sobel edge map for a coarse where-is-motion-relative-to-edges estimate — still not a true dx/dy gradient flow. No CUDA, no external models — built entirely from stock TD TOPs: blurTOP (pre-blur), monochromeTOP, cacheTOP (previous-frame delay), compositeTOP subtract (frame diff), optional edgeTOP cross-multiply, mathTOP (sensitivity gain + 0.5 recenter), feedbackTOP+levelTOP (temporal smoothing). Defaults to TD's bundled Mosaic.mp4 test clip so the chain builds and previews standalone without a live camera (avoids macOS permission modal). Output is a nullTOP. Reads 0 when TD timeline is paused and the source is static — that is correct behavior. Returns a summary plus JSON with node paths, controls, warnings, and an inline preview image.

name.description: Name of the container COMP created under parent_path.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the optical flow container is created inside.

source.description: Absolute path of a TOP to analyze for motion (pulled in via selectTOP so it can live anywhere). Omit to use TD's bundled Mosaic.mp4 test clip so the chain previews standalone without a live camera (avoids macOS permission hang).

resolution.description: Output resolution [width, height] in pixels. Default is half-HD — CPU optical flow is bandwidth-bound; larger resolutions are slower.

sensitivity.description: Multiplier on the raw frame difference (before the 0.5 recenter). Higher values pick up subtler motion (and more noise). Maps to mathTOP gain.

smoothing.description: Temporal smoothing on the flow output (feedbackTOP cross-fade). 0 = raw per-frame flow (jittery); 1 = ghosted/laggy.

blur.description: Spatial pre-blur (pixels) on source before differencing — suppresses high-frequency camera noise. Maps to blurTOP size.

direction_from.description: 'diff' (default, cheapest): scalar frame-difference luminance (temporal motion energy). 'edges': cross frame-diff with Sobel edgeTOP for a coarse where-is-motion-relative-to-edges estimate — more flow-like but still a scalar, not a dx/dy vector, and ~2× cost.

tools.name: create_histogram_scope
tools.description: Build a luminance (and optional per-channel RGB) histogram video scope for any TOP. Computes the histogram on the GPU using a GLSL TOP (bins×1 output), samples into a CHOP, normalises, and renders through choptoSOP → renderTOP. Output is a single Null TOP ready for previews or bind_to_channel. Implements the roadmap Milestone 2 histogram scope panel as a standalone focused tool. This is the single-scope, working histogram (the one create_video_scopes can't render in TD 099); for a combined waveform/parade/vectorscope monitor use create_video_scopes.

source.description: Video source. 'test_pattern' = synthetic Banana.tif (no permission needed). 'existing_top' = reuse a TOP you already have (provide existing_top_path). 'file' = a video/image file. 'device' = live camera — may hang TD on a macOS permission modal.

existing_top_path.description: Path of an existing TOP to scope (source='existing_top').

mode.description: Histogram mode. 'luma' = single luminance trace. 'rgb' = three overlaid per-channel traces. Note: rgb mode is informational only in v1 — ships as luma with rgb flag in extra.

bins.description: Number of histogram bins (16..512). Drives the GLSL TOP output width. Changing after build requires a rebuild.

log_scale.description: Compress tall peaks with log(1+x) in the normalisation Math CHOP. Changing after build requires a rebuild.

trace_color.description: Phosphor tint colour for luma mode as a hex string. Ignored when mode='rgb'.

bar_style.description: Reserved — informational only in v1. Both values currently emit the same `choptoSOP`-fed render (a thin vertical strip per bin); a true polyline 'line' mode is planned. Setting this changes the value recorded in `extra` but does not yet change the SOP topology.

resolution.description: Output Null TOP size [width, height].

expose_controls.description: Bind live controls: Gain, TraceColor (luma mode), LogScale (informational).

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path; the histogram scope container is created as 'histogram_scope' inside it.

tools.name: create_safety_blackout_chain
tools.description: Build a live-show safety primitive at the very end of the master output chain: deterministic fade-to-black over a configurable time, optional emergency single-frame hard-cut, optional hotkey + external watchdog trigger, and symmetric fade-in recovery. All reactivity is parameter-driven (Speed + Lookup CHOP + Math/Logic CHOPs) — no Python runs at cook time, so the chain is ALLOW_EXEC=0-safe. Complements create_panic (per-source kill+freeze) by being the master-output dimmer with grace, recovery, and a watchdog hook. Returns the container, source, dim, emergency-gate, composite, and output node paths plus the trigger merge/target/speed/lookup nodes.

input_path.description: Absolute path of the master TOP to protect. Pulled in via a Select TOP (TD wires can't cross COMPs). If omitted, a Ramp TOP test source is used so the chain still builds + previews.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP the safety chain is built inside (default '/project1').

fade_seconds.description: Time the soft fade-to-black (and symmetric fade-in) takes. 0 = instant.

fade_curve.description: Interpolation shape for the fade ramp, applied via a Lookup CHOP curve so the ramp is deterministic and Python-free at cook time.

initial_state.description: Boot state. 'live' = pass-through, 'black' = Blackout toggle on at load, 'held' = Hold toggle on (good for show open before first cue).

arm_emergency_snap.description: Expose an Emergency momentary pulse that bypasses the fade and hard-cuts to black.

hotkey.description: Keyboard In CHOP key spec that toggles Blackout (e.g. 'ctrl.b'). null/empty disables — hotkey is opt-in safe, requires a modifier.

watchdog_channel.description: Optional absolute CHOP path + channel ('node:channel') — when non-zero, forces Blackout on. Lets external monitors trigger blackout deterministically without Python.

recovery_mode.description: When the watchdog returns to 0: 'manual' keeps it black until the artist clears it; 'auto_on_clear' fades back in.

show_safe_label.description: Optional caption baked into the black frame (Text TOP composited over the dimmed output). Empty/null = no caption.

expose_controls.description: Build the control panel with Blackout / Emergency / Fade Seconds / State LED.

tools.name: create_setlist_runner
tools.description: Layer-1 wall-clock setlist player for rehearsed VJ shows. Pass `rows[]` of (source TOP, duration_seconds, transition_seconds) and the tool builds a baseCOMP containing N Select TOPs (one per row), a Switch TOP, a Cross TOP for crossfaded boundaries (hard cut when transition_seconds=0), an optional NOW/NEXT/remaining Text TOP HUD composited over the program, a Timer CHOP + CHOP Execute engine that auto-advances rows on wall-clock time, and live custom params Play/Row/Skip/Prev/Loop/Defaulttransition for stage overrides. Output is a Null TOP at `<parent>/<name>/out`. Fills the gap between create_clip_launcher (manual grid) and create_cue_sequencer (musical bars).

source.description: Path of an existing TOP to switch to (e.g. '/project1/moviefilein1') OR a logical name resolved against `sources_map`. Required.

duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds this row plays before auto-advancing (must be > 0).

transition_seconds.description: Crossfade duration to the NEXT row at the boundary; 0 = hard cut via Switch TOP. Defaults to `default_transition` when omitted.

label.description: Display name in the HUD. Defaults to the source basename.

rows.description: Ordered setlist rows. Each row: { source, duration_seconds, transition_seconds }.

sources_map.description: Optional `{ logical → TOP path }` to allow human-readable row sources like 'actA' instead of an absolute path.

default_transition.description: Fallback `transition_seconds` (in seconds) for rows that omit it.

loop.description: When the last row ends: wrap to row 0 (true) or stop (false).

show_hud.description: Build the NOW/NEXT/remaining Text TOP HUD as a child output.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path where the engine COMP is created (e.g. '/project1').

tools.name: create_show_failover
tools.description: Build a live-show watchdog: a Switch TOP (blend=1 cross-dissolve) between a primary source TOP (NDI/camera/Spout/Syphon path, or a synthetic noiseTOP when none is given) and an MP4 fallback (or a constantTOP when no file is given), driven by an Info CHOP + watchdog CHOP-Execute DAT that trips on cook stall (total_cooks delta stays flat for stall_ms) and, optionally, primary cook errors. A Filter CHOP smooths the integer Switch index into a fade_ms crossfade. Sticky-recover auto-returns to primary after recover_ms healthy; otherwise stays on fallback until Reset. Exposes Active / Stall_Ms / Fade_Ms / Sticky_Recover / Reset / Force_Fallback controls and a Null CHOP of status channels for bind_to_channel. Returns the container, output TOP, status CHOP, control names, and the operator paths.

primary_path.description: Absolute TD path to the primary source TOP (NDI/camera/Spout/Syphon/any TOP). Empty → builds a synthetic noiseTOP so the network is offline-safe.

fallback_file.description: Filesystem path to the fallback MP4 / still. Empty → a constantTOP (dark grey) is used as a safe fallback.

stall_ms.description: Consecutive ms of zero cook progress before failover trips.

fade_ms.description: Crossfade duration in ms (0 = hard cut). Drives the Filter CHOP that smooths the Switch TOP index.

sticky_recover.description: When true, auto-switch back to primary after `recover_ms` of healthy cooking. When false, stays on fallback until Reset is pressed.

recover_ms.description: Healthy duration before auto-recover (only used when sticky_recover=true).

watch_errors.description: Also trip on primary cook errors (`errors > 0`), not just on stall.

status_overlay.description: Composite a small LIVE/FALLBACK badge (textTOP + compTOP) into the output.

parent_path.description: Where to create the show_failover system container.

tools.name: create_pose_reactive
tools.description: Body-pose binder parallel to bind_audio_reactive: take the 33-sample MediaPipe pose CHOP produced by setup_body_tracking and derive scalar reactive channels (right-hand height, arms openness, elbow angle, hand velocity, …) on a Null CHOP ready for bind_to_channel. Each channel is a Select→Math→Hold→Filter→Limit→Rename chain inside a fresh baseCOMP, all merged into one null_out. Supported metrics: y/x/z (1 landmark), distance/openness (2 landmarks), angle (3 — vertex middle), velocity (1, time-derivative). Optional `bindings[]` writes expression-mode binds directly onto target parameters (same shape as bind_to_channel; failures collected as warnings, not throws). Exposes a Reactive custom page with Smoothing/Intensity/Bypass/Gate_<name> knobs. Heads-up: MediaPipe's `landmarks` are 2D (z near-zero) — z/distance/angle/velocity are unreliable unless the adapter exposes `worldLandmarks`; the tool emits a warning when it detects a constant tz. Run setup_body_tracking first.

source_chop.description: Path to the 33-sample MediaPipe pose CHOP (tx/ty/tz/confidence channels) — typically the Null produced by setup_body_tracking.

name.description: Output channel name on the Null CHOP, e.g. 'right_hand_y'. Must be unique.

metric.description: How to derive a scalar from the landmarks: y/x/z (1 landmark), distance (2), angle (3, vertex middle), velocity (1, time-derivative of position), openness (2, shoulder-pair distance).

landmarks.description: MediaPipe pose landmark IDs (0..32). Counts by metric: y/x/z/velocity=1, distance/openness=2, angle=3 (vertex middle).

clamp.description: Final clamp range [min,max]; set both null to skip clamping.

confidence_gate.description: If landmark confidence < gate, hold the last value (Hold CHOP).

channels.description: Reactive channels to derive. Landmark IDs cheat-sheet — 0 nose, 11 L-shoulder, 12 R-shoulder, 13 L-elbow, 14 R-elbow, 15 L-wrist, 16 R-wrist, 23 L-hip, 24 R-hip, 25 L-knee, 26 R-knee, 27 L-ankle, 28 R-ankle.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path.

bindings.description: Optional list of parameter paths to bind to the derived channels (expression-mode bind, like bind_audio_reactive).

param.description: Target parameter, dotted path: '/project1/myComp:Speed' — same shape as bind_to_channel.

expose_controls.description: Append Smoothing/Intensity/Bypass/Gate_<name> knobs to the container.

tools.name: create_pose_controlnet_driver
tools.description: Render a canonical OpenPose-colored stick figure TOP (per-limb RGB lines + per-joint colored discs on a black background, default 512×512) from an existing pose CHOP produced by create_pose_tracking. The render is GPU-rasterized in a single GLSL TOP that samples the pose CHOP via a CHOP-to-TOP. Optionally auto-wires the output to a Syphon/Spout or NDI sender for a downstream Stable Diffusion / ComfyUI / StreamDiffusion ControlNet node. No model inference — this tool produces the driver conditioning image that ControlNet consumes.

source.description: Where the pose stream comes from. 'existing_tracker' reads a 33-sample pose CHOP at pose_chop_path. 'synthetic' auto-spins-up a synthetic Script CHOP inside this container for device-free preview.

pose_chop_path.description: Required when source='existing_tracker'. Absolute TD path to the canonical 33-sample pose CHOP (tx/ty/tz/confidence).

resolution.description: Square render size. ControlNet SD1.5 wants 512; SDXL wants 768/1024.

joint_radius.description: Filled-disc radius (px) for each keypoint joint. Exposed as live JointRadius knob.

limb_thickness.description: Line thickness (px) for each limb. Exposed as live LimbThickness knob.

coordinate_space.description: How to map landmark tx/ty to pixel space. 'normalized' maps [-1,+1] to full square. 'world' recenters using hip_midpoint and auto-scales to body height.

mirror.description: Flip horizontally (selfie cam vs. ControlNet expectation).

confidence_gate.description: Skip drawing landmarks/limbs whose endpoint confidence falls below this. Exposed as live knob.

color_preset.description: Canonical OpenPose 18-keypoint COCO palette by default.

custom_limb_colors.description: When color_preset='custom'. Length must equal 17 (limb count).

custom_joint_colors.description: When color_preset='custom'. Length must equal 18 (joint count).

output_mode.description: When 'internal' stops at a Null TOP. When 'syphon_spout'/'ndi' adds an FM-01 external sender.

sender_name.description: Sender/source name advertised on the network when output_mode != 'internal'.

expose_controls.description: Expose live JointRadius, LimbThickness, ConfidenceGate, Mirror knobs.

parent_path.description: Parent network for the pose_controlnet_driver baseCOMP.

tools.name: create_ascii_render
tools.description: Turn any TOP into a character-grid ASCII render: quantise input luminance into a (W/cell × H/cell) grid, then look up each glyph from a monospace character atlas. Supports mono, source-color (per-cell tint), and two-color (lerp by luminance) modes. Phosphor-green default for the Severance / CRT terminal look. Creates a resolutionTOP (cells), textTOP (atlas), glslTOP, and nullTOP output inside a new baseCOMP. Exposes Mix, CellSize, and Charset controls.

name.description: Base name for the created container.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the ASCII render container is created inside.

source.description: Absolute path of an existing TOP to render as ASCII (e.g. '/project1/movie1'). If omitted, a self-contained animated colour-noise source is used (no device permissions).

charset.description: Dark→light glyph ramp. Min 2 chars, max 32. Leading spaces add more 'black' room.

cell_size.description: Pixel size of each character cell. min 4, max 64.

color_mode.description: mono: fixed fg on bg; source-color: per-cell average tint; two-color: lerp(bg,fg) by luminance.

fg_color.description: Foreground glyph colour [r,g,b] 0–1. Phosphor-green default. Used in mono/two-color.

bg_color.description: Background colour [r,g,b] 0–1. Used in all modes.

font.description: Monospace font fed to the atlas textTOP.

mix.description: Blend between original (0) and ASCII output (1). Live-tweakable.

resolution.description: Output resolution [width, height] in pixels.

tools.name: create_phrase_locked_cue_engine
tools.description: Build a DJ/VJ phrase-quantized cue-lock engine. Any incoming pulse CHOP (Button, MIDI In, OSC In, composeCueList trigger) is queued FIFO and fired on the next 1/2/4/8/16/32/64-bar phrase boundary derived from the global project tempo. Live controls: Active (on/off gate), PhraseLength (live retune), Flush (clear queue), QueueDepth (display). Mode 'next' fires on the first upcoming boundary; 'aligned' locks to the project-start phrase grid. Pairs with create_tempo_sync upstream and bind_to_channel / manage_cue downstream. Output is a 0/1 trigger Null CHOP at <container>/out.

pending_chop_path.description: Path to a CHOP whose first channel is the 'pending cue' pulse. Every time it rises 0→1 a cue is enqueued; the gated trigger fires it on the next phrase boundary. Wire a Button COMP, OSC In CHOP, MIDI In CHOP, or composeCueList trigger into this channel.

phrase_length_bars.description: Phrase length in bars. 16 is the DJ/VJ standard for builds/drops. Restricted to powers of 2 (1/2/4/8/16/32/64) — the canonical phrase grid; arbitrary values break the modulo lock.

quantize_mode.description: 'next' (default): fire on the NEXT bar where (bar % phrase_length == 0), which is the upcoming phrase downbeat. 'aligned': only fire at a phrase downbeat that is also bar 1 of the bar-1-anchored phrase grid (bar % phrase_length == 0 AND bar >= phrase_length) — strict alignment from project start. For most live use, 'next' is what you want.

queue_capacity.description: Max queued pending cues. Extra pulses while at capacity are dropped (warning logged in storage).

expose_controls.description: Expose live PhraseLength / Active / Flush / QueueDepth controls on the engine container.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP. Self-contained engine container is created here.

tools.name: create_pop_particle_system
tools.description: Build a complete POP particle simulation (particle_pop → feedback_pop → lookup_texture_pop → field_pop → null_pop) inside a new baseCOMP, wire a render rig (poptoSOP → geometryCOMP → renderTOP → nullTOP), and expose EmissionRate, Lifetime, FeedbackGain, and ForceTexture live controls. When force_texture_path is omitted, a noiseTOP is created inside the container as the default force source so the chain always cooks. Supports three output modes: 'particles' (particle render), 'field' (field_pop visualization), and 'composite' (compositeTOP add of both). POP chain creation is delegated to build_pop_chain (Layer 2); this tool adds only the render rig and control exposure. This is the only particle tool built on TouchDesigner's native POP operators (force-texture driven, with field/composite output modes); pick a sibling instead for non-POP paths: create_gpu_particle_field for a GPU noise/curl/gravity drift field, create_particle_flock for GPU boids/flocking, image_to_particles to reconstruct an image/video as points, create_particle_system for a simple CPU emitter. NOTE: POPs are Experimental — the result carries an unverified marker; live-validate.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path (default '/project1').

emission_rate.description: Particle birth rate per second; mapped to particle_pop birthrate and exposed as EmissionRate knob.

lifetime.description: Particle lifetime in seconds; mapped to particle_pop life/lifeexpect. Exposed as Lifetime knob.

force_texture_path.description: Existing TOP path to drive the force field via lookup_texture_pop.par.top. If omitted, a noiseTOP is created inside the container as the default force source.

feedback_gain.description: Feedback strength on feedback_pop (mapped to inputmul). Exposed as FeedbackGain knob.

output.description: Which TOP the output nullTOP mirrors. 'particles' = render of particle_pop chain; 'field' = rendered field_pop visualization; 'composite' = compositeTOP (add) of both.

resolution.description: Render TOP resolution [width, height].

tools.name: create_pop_growth
tools.description: Build a POP-native reaction-diffusion / growth system inside a fresh baseCOMP. Three mode presets: 'dendritic' (sparse fibrous tendrils, low decay), 'coral' (dense outward accretion, mid decay, strong force), 'lichen' (patchy crust, high threshold emission clusters). A particle_pop emits points gated by a noise threshold; a noise_pop drives a force_pop vector field that biases their motion; a feedback_pop loop carries point state forward one cook so accumulation simulates organic growth. Output is a Null TOP via poptoSOP → geometryCOMP → renderTOP. POP chain delegated to buildPopChainScript. POPs are Experimental — par writes are fail-forward; result reports unverified op/par set. Warns when feedback_gain × (1 − decay) ≥ 1.0 (divergence risk).

mode.description: Preset selector — picks the default param bundle. 'dendritic': sparse fibrous tendrils; 'coral': dense outward accretion; 'lichen': patchy emission clusters.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP where the container is built.

growth_rate.description: Particle birth rate per cook (drives particle_pop birth/rate par defensively). Overrides preset.

decay.description: Per-frame multiplier applied through the feedback loop (1 − decay retained). Overrides preset.

threshold.description: Emission gate: noise sample below threshold suppresses new births. Overrides preset.

feedback_gain.description: Scale of the feedback contribution mixed back into the active POP each frame; >1 risks divergence. Overrides preset.

force_scale.description: Amplitude of the noise-driven force_pop vector field. Overrides preset.

noise_freq.description: Spatial frequency of the noise_pop. Overrides preset.

max_points.description: Safety cap on particle count (passed defensively as numpoints/maxparticles).

resolution.description: Render TOP + Null TOP resolution [width, height].

expose_controls.description: Expose GrowthRate / Decay / Threshold / FeedbackGain knobs on the container.

tools.name: create_pop_lines_pointcloud
tools.description: Plexus-style line-web visual built on the POP family. A POP point cloud (auto-generated or sourced) is fed to a Neighbor POP that fills a per-point Nebr array attribute with closest-neighbor indices. A Script SOP converts that index list into deduplicated line primitives, rendered as a Geometry COMP through a Render TOP to a Null TOP — the classic Plexus look without third-party plugins. auto_pattern: 'noise' (default) = pointgeneratorPOP + noisePOP; 'sphere' = spherePOP; 'grid' = gridPOP. count is hard-capped at 8192 (CPU O(N·k) line emission). color_mode: flat | by_distance (warm→cool gradient) | by_neighbor_count (isolation ramp). Exposes live controls: MaxDistance, MaxNeighbors, Spin, PointSize, LineAlpha. POPs are Experimental — par names and Nebr array-attribute survival through poptoSOP are probe-first unverified; result carries extra.unverified.

name.description: Container base name; final path uses TD auto-suffix.

parent_path.description: Parent network for the system container.

source_path.description: If set, must point to an existing POP/SOP that produces a point cloud. When omitted, a point cloud is auto-generated per auto_pattern.

auto_pattern.description: Used only when source_path is undefined. noise = pointgeneratorPOP + noisePOP; sphere = spherePOP; grid = gridPOP.

count.description: Approx point count when auto-generating. Hard-capped at 8192 (line emission is O(N·k) on CPU).

max_distance.description: Radius (POP world units) the Neighbor POP searches for neighbors. Drives Plexus density.

max_neighbors.description: Per-point neighbor cap (neighborPOP.maxneighbors). Higher = denser web.

max_lines.description: Hard cap on emitted line primitives in the Script SOP (after dedupe).

color_mode.description: Drives Cd attribute on the SOP. flat = single color; by_distance = per-line gradient; by_neighbor_count = per-point ramp on isolation.

color.description: Line color used directly in flat mode, as warm endpoint in by_distance, as dense endpoint in by_neighbor_count.

line_alpha.description: Constant MAT alpha; < 1 lets lines additively glow.

spin.description: Y-axis degrees/sec spin of the whole field via Transform POP ry expression.

point_size.description: Optional point overlay size rendered in addition to lines. 0 hides points.

resolution.description: Render TOP resolution [width, height].

expose_controls.description: Skip control panel exposure when false.

tools.name: create_depth_pop_field
tools.description: Build a depth-driven GPU POP scatter field: consumes a depth/mask TOP and uses lookup_texture_pop to sample depth for displacement/scatter proxies (and optionally color). When depth_top_path is omitted, auto-spins-up a setup_segmentation MediaPipe chain inside the container and uses its mask Null TOP as the depth source. Scatter modes: 'displace' applies a uniform depth-scale proxy, 'emit' adds an emission-like jitter scatter proxy, 'both' does both. Forward-compatible: pass create_depth_from_2d (Depth Anything, W4) output as depth_top_path. NOTE: POPs are Experimental — op types and par names are fail-forward, probe on a live TD. Returns a JSON block with container path, depth source info, controls, warnings, and unverified probe record.

name.description: Name for the self-contained container created under parent_path.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path where the depth-pop-field container is created.

depth_top_path.description: Absolute path of an existing depth/mask TOP (luminance = depth, bright = near by default). When omitted, the tool auto-spins-up a setup_segmentation chain inside the container and uses its mask Null TOP as the depth source. Future W4: pass create_depth_from_2d output here.

particle_density.description: Approximate point count fed to pointgeneratorPOP.numpoints (100–500 000).

scatter_mode.description: 'displace' = uniform depth-scale proxy on the point cloud; 'emit' = emission-like scatter jitter around the sampled depth field; 'both' = depth-scale proxy + scatter jitter. True depth-weighted birth is unverified.

depth_scale.description: Multiplier on the depth-driven displacement amount along +Z for displace/both scatter modes. Exposed as DepthScale knob when that displacement proxy is active.

color_by_depth.description: When true, copies sampled RGBA into POP Color attribute via a second lookup_texture_pop (near = bright / far = dark).

invert_depth.description: Treat dark as near instead of bright. Implemented via Level TOP invert on a proxy feed.

point_size.description: Render TOP point size, exposed as PointSize knob.

spin.description: Y-rotation of the field in deg/sec, animated via transformPOP ry expression. Exposed as Spin knob.

resolution.description: Render TOP resolution [width, height].

expose_controls.description: Build the live artist knobs panel for the active depth field controls.

tools.name: create_stipple_pointcloud
tools.description: Density-weighted particle scatter rendered as discrete points — a stippled / halftone-engraving point cloud whose dot distribution follows the luminance of a source TOP. Brighter regions yield denser clusters. Three visual modes: bw_dots (constant colour stipple), colored_dots (sample source RGB at each point), random_jitter (adds noisePOP for organic hand-engraved scatter). Outputs a Render TOP through a Geometry COMP in points render mode. Sibling to create_pop_geometry (procedural SOP geo) and the rasterised create_dither / create_halftone tools (which stay in TOP space).

parent_path.description: Parent COMP to create the container under.

name.description: Base name for the system container (TD auto-suffixes).

source_top_path.description: Absolute path of an existing TOP whose luminance drives density. When omitted, a rampTOP radial gradient is built as the source.

dot_size.description: Point primitive size in pixels (0.5..8, default 2).

density.description: Total particle count (100..200000, default 20000). Drives maxparticles + birthrate.

mode.description: Visual treatment: bw_dots (constant colour), colored_dots (sample source RGB per-point), random_jitter (adds noisePOP for organic scatter).

color_mode.description: Background/foreground choice for bw_dots and random_jitter. Ignored by colored_dots.

palette_color.description: Foreground RGB tuple when color_mode=palette. Default warm parchment [0.95, 0.9, 0.7].

jitter_amount.description: Per-point position noise scale for random_jitter mode (0..1, default 0.25).

resolution.description: Output Render TOP resolution [w, h]. Default [1280, 720].

expose_controls.description: When true, expose live DotSize, JitterAmount (random_jitter only), and CameraRotate controls.

tools.name: drive_streamdiffusion
tools.description: Wraps the community StreamDiffusionTD.tox (by dotsimulate) into a one-shot Layer 1 setup: locate the .tox via candidate-path discovery, drop it into a fresh baseCOMP, wire a camera/source TOP into its input, set the prompt/strength/cfg/seed custom pars, and optionally re-broadcast the output via Syphon/Spout or NDI. Returns a friendly error when the .tox is not installed. The result envelope includes validated_pars so downstream tools (create_ai_mirror) know which SD pars to bind a control panel to.

tox_path.description: Optional explicit absolute or project-relative override. When set, becomes the only candidate; standard discovery is skipped.

source_top_path.description: File system path to a video/image file to feed into the StreamDiffusionTD container (creates a moviefileinTOP). When omitted, a synthetic noise TOP is created for device-free preview.

prompt.default: a vibrant neon cyberpunk portrait, ultra detailed
prompt.description: Sets the Prompt custom par on the tox.

strength.description: img2img denoising strength — sets Strength par.

cfg.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. Low CFG (1–2) is normal for StreamDiffusion/LCM.

seed.description: Random seed. -1 = random per tox convention.

controlnet_weight.description: Sets Controlnetweight when the par is present in the tox build.

t_index.description: Sets Tindex (denoise step list index) when present; omitted = tox default.

output_mode.description: internal = Null TOP only. syphon_spout / ndi = adds an FM-01 sender wired from out1.

parent_path.description: Parent network for the fresh streamdiffusion_driver baseCOMP.

expose_controls.description: Reserved for v2 — the tox already surfaces its own UI; this field is accepted but not acted on in v1.

tools.name: setup_mediapipe_plugin
tools.description: Drop the torinmb mediapipe-touchdesigner ENGINE in one shot and enable any combination of face, hand, body, and segmentation pipelines. Use this instead of running setup_face_tracking + setup_hand_tracking + setup_body_tracking + setup_segmentation separately — those tools each re-load the engine, resulting in multiple competing MediaPipe COMPs fighting for the webcam. This tool loads the engine ONCE and toggles its Face/Hand/Body/Segmentation pars. IMPORTANT: there is NO stock TouchDesigner MediaPipe; all five mediapipe tools (this one + the four setup_*_tracking tools) rely on the free torinmb plugin — install it first with `tdmcp install mediapipe-touchdesigner`. Output paths for face/hand/body are DATs (JSON landmark streams from the plugin), not CHOPs — use a Script CHOP adapter to convert to numeric channels. The engine requires the TD timeline to be PLAYING (uses an embedded browser for webcam capture).

tox_path.description: Override path to the torinmb mediapipe-touchdesigner ENGINE .tox (MediaPipe.tox — the full tracker with webcam capture, NOT the bare pose_tracking.tox or hand_tracking.tox processors). Defaults to the package staged by `tdmcp install mediapipe-touchdesigner`.

parent_path.description: Existing COMP to load the engine into.

enable_face.description: Enable the Face detection pipeline inside the engine.

enable_hand.description: Enable the Hand tracking pipeline inside the engine.

enable_body.description: Enable the Body/Pose tracking pipeline inside the engine.

enable_segmentation.description: Enable the Segmentation pipeline (outputs a matte TOP; heavier GPU cost than the landmark pipelines).

source_video_path.description: Optional path to a video file to use as input instead of the live webcam. The engine's Camera/Source/Videofile/File par is probed in that order and the first match is set.

container_name.description: Inner baseCOMP name. Matches the default used by setup_body_tracking / setup_hand_tracking so re-running is idempotent (the engine is reused, not duplicated).

tools.name: create_depth_from_2d
tools.description: Wraps TDDepthAnything v2 (community TOX by IntentDev) to convert any 2D image/video TOP into a depth map TOP using Depth Anything v2 via NVIDIA TensorRT/ONNX — no Kinect or RealSense required. Given a source TOP path, drops the TOX into a fresh container, wires the source, exposes a depth Null TOP whose path can be fed directly into create_depth_displacement, create_depth_pop_field, or create_depth_silhouette. Requires the user to have installed TDDepthAnything.tox from https://github.com/IntentDev/TDDepthAnything and an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA + TensorRT pre-built weights (.engine/.onnx). NOT supported on macOS. First cook may take 30–60 s for engine compile. Returns container_path, dropped_tox_path, depth_top_path (the key output), source_top_path, output_resolution, model_variant, and warnings.

source_top_path.description: Absolute TD path of the 2D source TOP (movieFileInTOP / videoDeviceInTOP / NDI-in / any cooked TOP). Required.

tox_path.description: Override path to TDDepthAnything.tox. When omitted, candidates are tried in order. Set this when the TOX lives outside ~/Documents/Derivative.

output_resolution.description: Square inference resolution. Lower = faster, higher = sharper depth edges. Default 512 matches Depth Anything v2 sweet spot on a 30-series GPU.

model_variant.description: Depth Anything v2 model size. small = ~25 ms/frame on RTX 3070, large = ~80 ms but cleaner edges. The TOX must have the matching .engine/.onnx weight on disk.

parent_path.description: Parent network for the depth_from_2d baseCOMP.

tools.name: create_gaussian_splat_scene
tools.description: Drops the community TDGS .tox by Anglerfish-graphics into a fresh baseCOMP, loads a .ply or .splat Gaussian Splat asset, optionally binds an existing cameraCOMP, and exposes a clean output renderTOP at 720p–2160p. Assets can be exported from Polycam, Postshot, Luma, or Nerfstudio. The wrapper connects to any existing tdmcp camera rig (create_camera_orbit, XY pads, MIDI). REQUIREMENTS: TDGS by Anglerfish-graphics installed (https://github.com/Anglerfish-Graphics/TDGS); TouchDesigner build ≥2023.30000; CUDA-capable NVIDIA GPU on Windows. macOS and AMD GPUs are not supported by TDGS — the tool returns a friendly error. VRAM: 720p≈2GB, 1080p≈4-6GB, 1440p≈12GB+, 2160p≈16GB+ (OOM crashes TD — no friendly error, start at 720p on a laptop). Returns container_path, dropped_tox_path, output_top_path, camera_path, warnings, and a preview image.

splat_asset_path.description: Absolute path to a .ply or .splat Gaussian Splat asset. Export from Polycam, Postshot, Luma, or Nerfstudio.

tox_path.description: Optional explicit absolute path to TDGS.tox. When set, skips the standard candidate walk. Useful when TDGS lives in a non-standard packages directory.

camera_path.description: Absolute TD path to an existing cameraCOMP (e.g. one built by create_camera_orbit). When set, TDGS's camera reference par is bound to it. When unset, TDGS uses its internal default camera.

output_res.description: Output renderTOP resolution. 720p=1280×720, 1080p=1920×1080, 1440p=2560×1440, 2160p=3840×2160. WARNING: 1440p+ requires a discrete GPU with ≥12GB VRAM; 2160p will crash TD on OOM. Default 1080p.

container_name.description: Name of the outer baseCOMP created by createSystemContainer.

parent_path.description: Parent network for the baseCOMP (default '/project1').

expose_controls.description: When true (default), promotes SplatAssetPath, CameraRef, and OutputRes to the wrapper container as live knobs.

tools.name: create_ai_mirror
tools.description: Layer 1 COMBO: wires the canonical 2026 AI-mirror installation in one MCP call — camera (or synthetic / existing TOP) → StreamDiffusion (img2img live, delegated to drive_streamdiffusion) → Syphon/Spout/NDI/internal output → a prompt+strength+cfg control panel whose sliders and textDATs drive SD pars via .expr expressions. Panel only binds pars present in drive_streamdiffusion's validated_pars; missing pars are warned, not errored. Camera source on macOS triggers the OS permission dialog on first cook; fallback_to_synthetic keeps the rig alive when the camera is unavailable.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP.

source.description: Input source: USB camera (hype default), self-animated synthetic TOP, or an existing TOP routed through a Select.

camera_device_idx.description: USB camera device index when source='camera'.

fallback_to_synthetic.description: If camera creation fails, build a synthetic noise source instead of aborting.

strength.description: img2img mix; surfaced in the panel.

cfg.description: Classifier-free guidance scale; SD sweet spot 1–2.

output_mode.description: Output: syphon_spout (macOS/Windows showcase form), ndi (cross-host), or internal (no sender).

expose_control_panel.description: Build the prompt+sliders panel and wire .expr expressions to SD pars.

show_camera_preview.description: Add a small selectTOP preview of the camera inside the panel.

tools.name: create_slit_scan
tools.description: Build a slit-scan visual system: each row (or column) of the output samples a different past frame from a Cache TOP ring buffer, producing the classic 'time-as-space' stretched-time look (Floris Kaayk / Adam Magyar style). Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path` holding a source TOP, a Cache TOP ring buffer, a slit GLSL shader, and a Null output. When no `source_top_path` is given, a synthetic Noise TOP is used so the tool works headless / on CI without camera permission. Exposes a live 'Depth' knob. Note: GLSL compile is UNVERIFIED offline; cacheTOP 2D-array binding must be validated live in TouchDesigner. Memory cost at 1080p RGBA16 is ~depth × 32 MB; depth 600 ≈ 5 GB VRAM. Output freezes when the timeline is paused (cacheTOP stops recording — expected behaviour). Returns a summary plus a JSON block with the container path, created node paths, output path, exposed controls, warnings, and an inline preview image.

parent_path.description: Parent network where the slit-scan container is created (default '/project1').

name.description: Container name for the slit-scan system (default 'slit_scan').

source_top_path.description: Optional path to an existing TOP to scan (e.g. '/project1/videodevicein1'). When omitted a synthetic noiseTOP seed is created inside the container so the tool runs headless / on CI without camera permission.

cache_depth.description: Number of frames stored in the Cache TOP ring buffer (1–600, default 60). Memory cost: ~depth × W × H × 16 B at RGBA16. At 1080p, 600 frames ≈ 5 GB VRAM.

axis.description: Screen axis that carries time. 'y' = each row is a different past frame; 'x' = each column (default 'y').

direction.description: Which end of the axis is 'now'. '+y' = bottom row is the latest frame, top is oldest; '-y' reverses it. Must be compatible with axis (default '+y').

expose_controls.description: When true (default), expose a live 'Depth' knob on the container bound to cache.cachesize.

tools.name: create_chrome_blobs
tools.description: Builds a liquid-chrome / Y2K metaball generator: an animated Noise TOP (or external source) is blurred, thresholded into soft blobs, then a GLSL TOP renders a procedural environment-map chrome look (greyscale ramp + moving specular highlight) with 5 metal tints and 4 background modes. Creates a self-contained baseCOMP with Speed, Blob_Count, Metal_Color, and Background controls exposed on the container.

parent_path.description: Parent network where the chrome-blobs COMP is created (default '/project1').

name.description: Name for the system container COMP (default 'chrome_blobs').

source_top_path.description: Optional external TOP to use as the blob field (pulls in via Select TOP). When omitted, an animated Noise TOP generates the blobs.

count.description: Logical blob count — drives noise harmonics + blur/threshold params (1–32, default 8).

speed.description: Noise animation speed — controls the absTime.seconds multiplier on noise TX/TZ (0–4, default 0.5).

metal_color.description: Chrome tint palette for the GLSL environment-map shader (default 'silver').

background.description: Background behind the chrome blobs — black, white, studio (soft radial), or gradient (vertical chrome studio) (default 'black').

tools.name: create_vintage_lens
tools.description: Drape a vintage analog-film aesthetic over any TOP in one call. Chains barrel/pincushion lens distortion → chromatic aberration → vignette → film grain as four inline GLSL passes inside a new baseCOMP. Era presets (super8, vhs, 16mm, 80s_camcorder) load era-correct strength defaults; any per-param override wins. Returns a standard Layer 1 envelope with container path, node paths, output path, preview image, warnings, and the resolved strength values.

parent_path.description: Parent network where the vintage-lens container is created (default '/project1').

source_top_path.description: Path of the existing TOP to grade (e.g. '/project1/render1').

era.description: Era preset that sets default strength values; per-param overrides win.

distortion_strength.description: Barrel-distortion coefficient (UV warped from center). Overrides preset.

ca_strength.description: RGB-split offset magnitude (radial from center). Overrides preset.

vignette_strength.description: Edge darkening amount; 0 disables. Overrides preset.

tools.name: create_reaction_diffusion
tools.description: Build a Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion GPU simulation as a ready-to-use visual system. Delegates to the built-in 'reaction_diffusion' recipe (seed GLSL TOP → feedbackTOP → simulation GLSL TOP → null output), then overlays caller-provided Gray-Scott parameters (Feed rate F, Kill rate K, diffusion coefficients Da/Db) as GLSL uniforms, patches the shader so da/db use the uniforms instead of hard-coded constants, and optionally chains a rampTOP + lookupTOP for a color LUT (coral / spots / stripes / mitosis presets). Exposes a control panel with sliders for F, K, Da, Db, resolution, and a palette menu. Output node is a nullTOP ready for downstream wiring. 'iterations>1' is unverified — effective value is 1 with a warning.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the reaction-diffusion container is created inside.

name.description: Base name for the created container.

F.description: Gray-Scott feed rate (uniform uFeed). Controls how fast chemical A is replenished. Lower = sparser, more open patterns; higher = denser maze-like structures.

K.description: Gray-Scott kill rate (uniform uKill). Controls how fast chemical B is removed. Tune alongside F to shift between spots, stripes, and maze regimes.

Da.description: Diffusion rate of chemical A (uniform uDa). Default 1.0. Increasing slows pattern growth; the recipe default is 1.0.

Db.description: Diffusion rate of chemical B (uniform uDb). Default 0.5. Tuning relative to Da changes pattern sharpness.

iterations.description: Simulation steps per rendered frame. UNVERIFIED — feedbackTOP has no native cookrate param; effective value is 1 with a warning if >1 is requested. Field retained for forward-compatibility.

palette.description: Post-sim color LUT applied via a rampTOP + lookupTOP downstream of the GLSL simulation. 'coral' = deep-purple→magenta→cream→white; 'spots' = black→cyan→white; 'stripes' = indigo→green→yellow; 'mitosis' = blood-red→orange→bone-white; 'none' = raw simulation state (R=A, G=B).

resolution.description: Square simulation grid size in pixels. Overrides seed1.resolutionw/h. Higher values produce finer detail at higher GPU cost.

tools.name: create_pixel_sort
tools.description: Build a glitch-art pixel-sort effect that sorts pixels along rows or columns within luminance-thresholded regions, creating the signature Kim Asendorf–style horizontal/vertical streak aesthetic. Uses a multi-pass odd-even transposition sort over a glslTOP feedback chain. Sort key: luminance, hue, or saturation. Exposes Mix, Threshold, Iterations, Direction, and Reset for live tweaking. Defaults to a self-contained noiseTOP source when no input TOP is provided.

name.description: Base name for the created baseCOMP.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path. The pixel-sort container is created inside this path.

source_top_path.description: Absolute path to an existing TOP (e.g. '/project1/movie1'). Pulled in via a Select TOP. If omitted, a self-contained animated noiseTOP source is used (no device permissions).

threshold.description: Luminance gate [0..1]. Pixels with luminance >= threshold are sortable; others are locked in place. Live-tweakable.

axis.description: x = sort along rows (horizontal streaks), y = along columns (vertical streaks).

sort_by.description: Sort key: the channel the odd-even transposition sort compares on.

direction.description: descending puts bright/saturated pixels first — the canonical Asendorf look. Live-tweakable.

iterations.description: Number of odd-even sort passes to run via the Feedback TOP. Higher = closer to fully sorted but heavier cook. Live-tweakable.

mix.description: Blend between original (0) and sorted output (1). Live-tweakable.

resolution.description: Output resolution [width, height] in pixels.

tools.name: create_volumetric_field
tools.description: Build a stacked-slice fake-volumetric noise field: smoke, nebula, ember, ice, toxic or mono palettes. Architecture: Simplex 3D noiseTOP → optional displace+blur → cacheTOP (depth = slice_count) → viewer glslTOP (Beer-Lambert accumulation across slices, baked palette) → nullTOP output. NOTE: this is a stacked-2D-slice approximation, NOT a raymarched volume. There is no per-pixel ray traversal or SDF. For a true raymarcher see the planned create_volumetric_raymarch (L-effort follow-up). Cook cost scales roughly linearly with slice_count × resolution. Default 16 slices is the safe sweet spot; drop to 4–8 on integrated GPUs. Returns a summary JSON with container path, created node paths, the output path, exposed controls, any node errors, warnings, and an inline preview image.

parent_path.description: Parent network where the volumetric_field baseCOMP is created.

name.description: Container name (must start with a letter, alphanumeric + underscore).

density.description: How opaque/milky the field reads (0 = transparent, 1 = fully opaque). Maps to uDensity in the viewer shader.

turbulence.description: Noise evolution speed and swirl amplitude. Drives the displacement weight and noise period. 0 = flat/still field; skips the displace TOP.

color_map.description: Palette baked into the viewer GLSL shader: smoke (grey haze), nebula (purple/magenta), ember (orange/red), ice (blue/cyan), toxic (green), mono (black→white).

slice_count.description: Number of 2D z-slices stacked into the pseudo-volume. Build-time only — changing it rewires the cache stack. Higher = smoother depth but heavier cook (linear cost). Default 16 is the safe sweet spot.

expose_controls.description: Expose Density, Turbulence and ColorMap knobs on the container.

tools.name: create_voxel_stack
tools.description: Isometric voxel-stack renderer driven by any TOP. Builds a single instanced Geometry COMP (boxSOP, N=cols·rows instances up to 256×256) with a CHOP chain sampling luminance for column height and per-instance color. Color modes: source_color (sample TOP directly), palette (Monument-Valley pastel ramp), height_ramp (same palette, height-based). Isometric ortho cam (rx=-35.264°, ry=45°) by default; perspective available. Exposes HeightScale, VoxelSize, and RotateY controls. If source_top_path is omitted, an animated noiseTOP drives the stack.

parent_path.description: Parent network where the voxel stack container is created.

name.description: Base name for the container (defaults to 'voxel_stack').

source_top_path.description: Path to an existing TOP that drives heights and colors. If omitted, a built-in animated noiseTOP feeds the stack.

grid_size.description: Voxel grid cols × rows. Hard-capped at 256×256 (65k instances).

voxel_size.description: Cube edge length in world units; also the XZ spacing between voxels.

height_scale.description: Multiplier on luminance → Y translate. 0 = flat slab.

color_mode.description: Per-instance color: sample source TOP directly (source_color), look up into a palette ramp (palette), or use a default pastel height ramp (height_ramp).

palette.description: Ramp endpoints as [r,g,b] tuples (2–8 stops). Used only when color_mode='palette'. Defaults to a Monument-Valley pastel 5-stop ramp.

camera_mode.description: Isometric uses ortho camera at rx=-35.264°, ry=45° (classic iso). Perspective uses a standard 35mm orbit cam.

expose_controls.description: When true, expose HeightScale, RotateY, and VoxelSize knobs on the container.

tools.name: create_facade_mapping
tools.description: Build a multi-projector architectural facade rig: one source TOP fanned into N per-projector branches, each with Crop → Corner Pin keystone → edge-blend Ramp/Composite mask → Level brightness, plus per-projector Null outputs and a summary preview composite. Ships as a calibration skeleton; per-projector corners, color match, and (when 3D) camera transforms are left to live install alignment.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP where the facade mapping system is created.

name.description: Name of the generated Base COMP.

source_top_path.description: Absolute TOP path to fan out; required when source_mode='existing_top'.

source_mode.description: Synthetic builds a self-animated noiseTOP so the rig previews without an upstream feed.

projector_count.description: Number of projectors. Each projector gets its own branch and Null output.

blend_width.description: Edge-blend overlap region in pixels (alpha gradient width on inner edges).

blend_layout.description: How projectors tile: horizontal row, vertical column, or near-square grid.

facade_geometry_path.description: Optional absolute SOP/COMP path to a 3D facade model. PARTIAL/UNVERIFIED: when provided, builds a per-projector cameraCOMP + renderTOP + geometryCOMP stub.

blend_curve.description: Curve applied to the alpha gradient via Level gamma.

expose_controls.description: Build a Control Panel with per-projector brightness + global blend width/curve.

tools.name: create_step_repeat
tools.description: Tile a source TOP into a rows×cols brick/grid pattern with per-cell gap, position jitter, rotation jitter, and an optional brick/masonry half-tile row offset — all computed per-cell in a single GLSL TOP shader (stock TOPs only, no external files besides the optional source). Defaults to a built-in synthetic Noise TOP so the grid previews standalone on any install without a source (no external asset). Output is a nullTOP. Returns a summary plus JSON with node paths, live controls, warnings, and an inline preview image.

source_path.description: Absolute path of a TOP to tile (pulled in via selectTOP so it can live anywhere). Omit to use a built-in synthetic Noise TOP so the grid previews standalone on any install (no external asset needed).

gap.description: Fractional inset per cell (0 = tiles touch, 0.5 = half the cell is gap).

jitter_pos.description: Per-cell random position offset, fraction of a cell.

brick_offset.description: Shift alternating rows by half a tile (brick/masonry layout).

resolution.description: Output resolution [width, height] in pixels.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the self-contained 'step_repeat' container is created inside.

tools.name: create_pointer_reactive
tools.description: Turn mouse/pointer position and click into a first-class creative seed. Builds a Mouse In CHOP → normalized u/v (0..1) + velocity (vu/vv) + button, exposed on a 'pointer' Null CHOP ready for binding: op('…/pointer_reactive/pointer')['u'] / ['v'] / ['button'] / ['vu'] / ['vv']. A Sensitivity knob gains every channel. By default also builds a small visible demo — a bright dot that follows the pointer and leaves a decaying trail over a feedback field — so you immediately see it working; set demo=false to build only the CHOP chain (no image, no preview). multitouch is reserved for a future Panel-COMP touch source; this build always uses Mouse In and reports the limitation as a warning when requested. Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path`. Returns a summary plus a JSON block with the container path, created node paths, the pointer Null path, channel names, exposed controls, any node errors, and warnings.

multitouch.description: When true, note that true multitouch needs a Panel COMP touch source; this build always uses Mouse In (single pointer) and reports the limitation as a warning. Kept for forward-compat — it does not change what gets built.

demo.description: Also build a visible feedback-field demo the pointer pushes, so you see it working immediately (a bright dot that trails behind the mouse over a decaying feedback field).

sensitivity.description: Gain applied to every pointer channel (u, v, velocity, button) before the output.

resolution.description: Output resolution [width, height] in pixels for the demo feedback field.

parent_path.description: Parent network where the pointer-reactive container is created (default '/project1').

tools.name: create_interaction_zones
tools.description: Define N rectangular zones over a camera / motion input; each zone fires when motion in that region crosses a threshold. Builds a stock-TOP chain — a motion-energy TOP (monochrome → previous-frame cache → difference), then per zone a cropTOP (region isolate) + analyzeTOP average + toptoCHOP, merged into one level CHOP, then a scriptCHOP that emits per zone a `*_state` channel (0/1 active) and a `*_dwell` channel (seconds continuously active). Ends on a 'zones' Null CHOP as the bind point — wire cues via bind_to_channel to op('…/interaction_zones/zones')['zone0_state']. Camera-only (no depth cam). Source is a TOP pulled via selectTOP, or a built-in synthetic animated Noise TOP when omitted (offline-safe, cooks clean on any install with no external asset). A live Threshold knob tunes sensitivity. Zones are normalized rects (x,y = top-left corner, w,h = size); the top-left image convention is mapped to TD's bottom-left uv origin. Returns a summary plus JSON with the container path, created node paths, the zones Null path, per-zone state/dwell channel names, the zone definitions, threshold, and warnings (no preview image — the output is a CHOP, not a TOP).

source_path.description: TOP to watch for motion (pulled via selectTOP). Omit for a built-in synthetic animated Noise TOP that cooks clean on any install (offline-safe, no external asset).

name.description: Optional label for the zone; falls back to zone0, zone1, … when omitted.

x.description: Normalized left edge of the zone (0 = left, 1 = right), the top-left corner X.

y.description: Normalized top edge of the zone (0 = top, 1 = bottom), the top-left corner Y in image/UI convention. Internally mapped to TD's bottom-left uv origin.

w.description: Normalized width of the zone (fraction of image width).

h.description: Normalized height of the zone (fraction of image height).

threshold.description: Motion level above which a zone counts as active.

resolution.description: Analysis resolution [width, height] in pixels (cheap; motion detection is bandwidth-bound).

parent_path.description: Parent COMP the interaction-zones container is created inside (default '/project1').

name.description: Name of the container COMP created under parent_path.

tools.name: lidar_floor_tracker
tools.description: Build a floor-occupancy tracker scaffold for synthetic rehearsal, Ouster TOP, Leuze ROD4 CHOP, or UDP point input. Produces a tracked_points CHOP plus a floor preview TOP; hardware modes default inactive and remain explicitly unverified until a real sensor is connected.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path to build inside.

sensor.description: Sensor scaffold to create. Hardware modes stay inactive by default.

sensor_address.description: IP address for Ouster/Leuze hardware modes.

active.description: Enable live hardware input immediately. Defaults false for rehearsal safety.

expose_controls.description: Expose Threshold and Scale controls.

tools.name: create_terrain
tools.description: Build a procedural heightmap landscape: an animated Noise TOP height field displaces a subdivided Grid SOP along Z in a GLSL vertex-displacement MAT (real 2.5D geometry, elevation-shaded from a low→high colour ramp), lit by a key Light, framed by a raised angled Camera, and rendered. Optionally adds a flat translucent water plane at `water_level` and a camera-distance fog fade into the sky/background colour. Distinct from create_visual_system's 'terrain' keyword (which only maps to a noise_landscape recipe) — this is a dedicated, fully parameterized terrain pipeline with its own displacement material, water, and fog. Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path`. Exposes Height, Drift, WaterLevel, and Zoom controls. Returns a summary plus a JSON block with the container path, created node paths, output path, exposed controls, node errors, warnings, and an inline preview image.

subdivisions.description: Grid resolution (rows = cols). Higher = finer relief and smoother displacement, but more vertices to push. 160 gives a 160×160 plane.

height.description: Displacement amount along Z: how far bright pixels push the surface up. 0 = flat.

noise_period.description: Noise TOP period — larger = broader, smoother hills; smaller = tighter, rockier.

drift.description: Scroll speed of the noise height field along Z per second so the landscape slowly evolves. 0 = static terrain. Reads 0 when the TD timeline is paused.

low_color.description: Colour of the valleys / lowest elevation (RGB 0..1).

high_color.description: Colour of the peaks / highest elevation (RGB 0..1).

water.description: Add a flat translucent water plane at `water_level` cutting through the terrain.

water_level.description: Z elevation of the water plane, in the same units as `height`.

fog.description: Fade the far terrain into `background` by camera distance (volumetric-ish haze).

expose_controls.description: When true (default), expose live Height / Drift / WaterLevel / Zoom controls.

parent_path.description: Parent network where the terrain container is created (default '/project1').

tools.name: create_asemic_writing
tools.description: Generate a page of procedural asemic writing — random-but-writing-like glyph strokes that flow left-to-right along stacked baselines but spell nothing. A Script SOP lays out `rows` × `glyphs` cells; each glyph is a short chain of `strokes` control points walking a noise-perturbed pen, with italic `slant`, per-stroke `jitter`, and occasional pen-lifts (`lift_chance`) that break marks apart. The polylines are thickened into tube ink strokes and rendered with an orthographic camera as calligraphic line art on a coloured page. Deterministic per `seed`. Genuinely distinct from create_growth_system (L-system branches) and create_vector_lines (image-traced contours). Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path`. Exposes Jitter, Slant, Thickness, and Seed controls. Returns a summary plus a JSON block with the container path, created node paths, output path, exposed controls, node errors, warnings, and an inline preview image.

rows.description: Number of baselines (lines of writing) stacked top to bottom.

glyphs.description: Glyphs per row, laid left to right along the baseline.

strokes.description: Control points per glyph — more strokes = more elaborate, script-like marks.

jitter.description: How far the pen wanders vertically per stroke (fraction of the line height). 0 = flat dashes, 1 = wild scrawl.

slant.description: Italic slant applied to every glyph (x-shear per unit height). 0 = upright.

lift_chance.description: Probability the pen lifts (breaks the polyline) between adjacent strokes, giving disconnected marks.

thickness.description: Tube SOP radius for the rendered ink strokes.

seed.description: RNG seed — same seed reproduces the same page of writing.

parent_path.description: Parent network where the asemic-writing container is created (default '/project1').

tools.name: create_sdf_text
tools.description: Raymarch a text string as a signed-distance-field 3D slab: a Text TOP renders the glyphs to a mask, and a GLSL TOP treats that mask as an extruded distance field (glyph coverage in XY, closed by two Z planes at ±depth/2) so the letters read as solid, lit, rim-highlit 3D volumes that can spin. Distinct from create_sdf_field (primitive CSG only, no text) and create_text_3d (mesh-extruded text SOP) — this is the raymarched distance-field text look. The mask→SDF is approximate (coverage-derived, no external font SDF atlas required) and eased by `smoothing`. Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path`. Exposes CameraZ/Speed/StepCount/Intensity/Rotate/Fill/Edge/Background controls and previews the output. Returns a summary plus a JSON block with node paths, exposed controls, node errors, warnings, and an inline preview image.

text.description: The string to raymarch as SDF text.

font.description: Font family for the Text TOP that seeds the glyph mask (must be installed in TD).

bold.description: Render the seed text bold (thicker glyph coverage).

depth.description: Extrusion thickness of the raymarched text slab along Z (uDepth).

smoothing.description: How sharply the mask coverage maps to the XY distance field. Lower = crisper edges, higher = softer/rounder.

camera_z.description: Camera distance from the text (uCameraZ). Live 'CameraZ' control.

rotate.description: Y-axis rotation speed of the text (radians/s via uRotate * uTime). Live 'Rotate'. Reads 0 when the TD timeline is paused.

speed.description: Animation time multiplier (drives uTime). Live 'Speed' control.

fill_color.description: Letter body colour hex (e.g. '#ffd34d'). Live RGB swatch 'Fill'.

edge_color.description: Rim/edge highlight colour hex. Live RGB swatch 'Edge'.

background.description: Background / miss colour hex. Live RGB swatch 'Background'.

light_direction.description: Light direction, normalised in shader — baked as GLSL constant.

resolution.description: Output resolution [width, height] of the GLSL TOP.

expose_controls.description: Expose live CameraZ/Speed/StepCount/Intensity/Rotate/Fill/Edge/Background controls.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the self-contained 'sdf_text' container is created inside.

tools.name: create_vertex_displacement_mat
tools.description: Build a true vertex-shader displacement material: a GLSL MAT whose vertex stage offsets each vertex along its normal by procedural 3D noise (uTime-animated) or by the luminance of a sampled TOP (`texture_path`), so the mesh is physically deformed on the GPU. Distinct from the TOP-space image warps create_depth_displacement / create_displacement_warp — those push 2D pixels; this pushes mesh vertices. Assign it to your own Geometry COMP via `target_geo`, or omit it to build a self-contained demo (subdivided sphere + camera + light + render + Null) so the material previews standalone. Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path`. Exposes Amount, Frequency, and Speed controls bound to the MAT. Returns a summary plus a JSON block with the container path, created node paths, the material path, the output path (demo only), exposed controls, node errors, warnings, and (demo only) an inline preview image.

target_geo.description: Absolute path of an existing Geometry COMP to assign the displacement MAT to. Omit to build a self-contained demo (subdivided sphere + camera + light + render) so the material previews standalone.

texture_path.description: Absolute path of a TOP whose luminance drives the displacement instead of procedural noise. Omit to use built-in 3D noise.

amount.description: Displacement distance along each vertex normal (uAmount). 0 = undeformed.

frequency.description: Spatial frequency of the procedural noise (ignored when texture_path is set).

speed.description: Animation speed of the noise field (uTime scroll, cycles/s). 0 = static. Reads 0 when the TD timeline is paused.

demo_subdivisions.description: Demo sphere mesh resolution (only used when target_geo is omitted).

demo_color.description: Demo surface tint (RGB 0..1); shaded by facing + displacement. Demo only.

expose_controls.description: When true (default), expose live Amount / Frequency / Speed controls bound to the MAT.

parent_path.description: Parent network where the container (holding the MAT and, for the demo, the render chain) is created.

tools.name: controlled_disorder_grid
tools.description: Generate a rows×cols grid of quads (or outlined cells) with a single order↔chaos `disorder` knob: 0 = a perfect grid, 1 = full chaos. The one knob scales per-cell position, rotation, and scale jitter together — each hashed from the cell index in a single GLSL TOP so the pattern is stable and reproducible (the classic generative-design 'controlled randomness' / Schotter study, no external source). Set `outline: true` for line cells. Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path`. Exposes the live Disorder knob plus CellColor/Background swatches. Returns a summary plus a JSON block with node paths, exposed controls, node errors, warnings, and an inline preview image.

rows.description: Number of grid rows (top to bottom).

cols.description: Number of grid columns (left to right).

disorder.description: The single order↔chaos knob. 0 = a perfect grid; 1 = full chaos. Scales all per-cell position/rotation/scale jitter together.

pos_jitter.description: Max per-cell position offset at disorder=1 (fraction of a cell).

scale_jitter.description: Max per-cell scale variation at disorder=1 (fraction).

fill.description: Cell size within its slot (0..1); leaves gutters between cells.

outline.description: Draw outlined cells instead of filled quads (classic Schotter look).

line_width.description: Outline thickness (fraction of a cell); used only when outline=true.

cell_color.description: Cell / line colour hex (e.g. '#f2f2f2'). Live RGB swatch 'CellColor'.

background.description: Background colour hex. Live RGB swatch 'Background'.

resolution.description: Output resolution [width, height] of the GLSL TOP (square suits a grid).

expose_controls.description: Expose the live Disorder knob (and CellColor/Background swatches).

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the self-contained 'disorder_grid' container is created inside.

tools.name: create_blob_trace
tools.description: Trace the contour/outline of a blob or silhouette into vector line art: source → monochrome → blur → threshold (the blob mask, optionally inverted) → optional Edge (boundary-band only) → Trace SOP (mask-to-polyline) → wireframe render. This is the CONTOUR-TRACE complement to create_vector_lines (full image vectoriser) and export_sop_to_svg, and is distinct from create_blob_reactive (which tracks blob position/reactivity — it does not draw the outline). Source can be the live camera (may prompt for macOS permission), a movie file, an animated synthetic blob (testable without a camera), or an existing TOP. Creates a new baseCOMP under `parent_path`. Exposes Threshold, Blur, and LineWidth controls. Returns a summary plus a JSON block with the container path, created node paths, output path, exposed controls, node errors, warnings, and an inline preview image.
